notes.title: Fallout 76 Update Notes – January 24, 2023
notes.content:
Our latest update for Fallout 76 launches today, and it's bringing a host of bug fixes, gameplay improvements, and more. Read on for a full list of patch notes for today's update.

[hr][/hr]

[h3] Update Version 1.7.2.18[/h3]

Check the download sizes below for today's patch on your platform of choice:
[list]
[*][b]PC (Steam):[/b] 5.6 GB
[*][b]PC (Microsoft Store):[/b] 15.08 GB
[*][b]PlayStation:[/b] 14.5 GB
[*][b]Xbox:[/b] 14.9 GB
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h3] Design Changes & Improvements[/h3]

[h5] Weapon Changes[/h5]

Although we are playing in a post-apocalyptic world, we still want to keep that world fair, fun, and inviting to all. While you have been exploring and rebuilding, we have been working on a new system that works behind the scenes to remove illegal attachment combinations that violate the EULA to ensure that every single player is using and trading the same items and has the same advantages as you.

In today's update, we are implementing a system that will remove illegal mods attached to weapons that cannot be obtained in-game. Most players will not notice any change to their existing weapons, however, players who are in possession of a weapon with a mod that cannot be equipped naturally to the weapon may notice a damage decrease to the weapon, and the mod will no longer exist.

[hr][/hr]

[h3] Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3]

[h5] Art & Animation[/h5]
[list]
[*][b]Backpack Flairs:[/b] Various adjustments to the view of Backpack flairs in the crafting menu. 
[*][b]Cryolater[/b] : Made adjustments to the frosted texture on the weapon model. 
[*][b]Flairs:[/b] Increased the Zoom out of Backpacks to allow more visibility on the flairs. 
[*][b]Loot Bags:[/b] Various fixes to Loot bag skins that were missing collision. 
[*][b]Power Armor:[/b] Adjustments to the player's 1st person view while wearing the Alien Invader Power Armor Paint and using a Heavy Weapon. 
[*][b]Power Armor:[/b] Fixed an issue where X-01 Prototype paint could not be reapplied after changing paints or skins. 
[*][b]Power Armor:[/b] Fixed an issue that can change the color of the highlighted weapon parts at a weapons workbench after entering and exiting Power Armor. 
[*][b]Rifles[/b] : Applying the Aligned Stock mod to a Laser Rifle or Ultracite Rifle now changes its appearance to reflect the mod. 
[*][b]Vault-Girl Arm Wrestle Machine:[/b] The player character no longer clips through the machine during its animation. 
[*][b]Weapon Paint:[/b] The Nuka-Dark paint for pump action shotguns now displays correctly. 
[/list]

[h5] Audio[/h5]
[list]
[*][b]Scout's Banner:[/b] Using a Scout Banner now plays the correct sound effect while being used. 
[*][b]Weapons:[/b] The spinning barrel sound effect from Miniguns, Gatling Plasmas, Gatling Lasers, and Pepper Shakers now stops when entering water. 
[/list]
[h5] C.A.M.P.s & Shelters[/h5]
[list]
[*][b]Allies:[/b] The proper name is now displayed for Sam, Katherine, and Xeno when inspecting or placing Allies in the players C.A.M.P. 
[*][b]Buffs:[/b] The 9 Ball Table now correctly provides a +2 Charisma buff to players after being used. 
[*][b]Buffs:[/b] The Spore Plant Bed now correctly gives the Well Rested Bonus after being used. 
[*][b]Displays[/b] : The Thirst Zapper can now be displayed on the full-sized Wall Weapon Rack. 
[*][b]FreeCam:[/b] Players can no longer place floor objects on top of their character while in FreeCam mode. 
[*][b]Message Board:[/b] Neon Letters can now be applied to the Message Board Kiosk. 
[*][b]Roofs:[/b] The Abandoned Mine C.A.M.P. Kit Roof now correctly uses the same amount of budget as other roof corner variants. 
[*][b]Trophies:[/b] Fixed an issue that caused Nuclear Winter trophies and statues to not be buildable in C.A.M.P.s and Shelters.
[*][b]Pirate Ship:[/b] Adjustments to the collision and snapping on the Landlubber Pirate Ship and Sea Legs Pirate Ship. 
[*][b]Radioactive Holiday Tree:[/b] Fixed an issue where the Radioactive Holiday Tree would leave persistent radiation when stored in a Blueprint. 
[*][b]Recipes:[/b] Players who have learned the recipe for Cappy and Bottle's Couple Sign can now correctly build the object. 
[*][b]Survival Tent:[/b] Fixed an issue which could prevent players from fast traveling to their team member's APC Survival Tent. 
[*][b]Watch post Prefab:[/b] Fixed the collision on the top stair. 
[/list]
[h5] Challenges[/h5]
[list]
[*][b]Nuka-World on Tour:[/b] Events completed in Nuka-World on Tour now correctly count towards "Complete Events in the Ash Heap" Challenge. 
[/list]
[h5] Enemies[/h5]
[list]
[*][b]Mad Dog Malone:[/b] When in his downed state, Mad Dog Malone no longer appears in the nearby corpse's menu. 
[/list]
[h5] Environment[/h5]
[list]
[*][b]Garrahan Mining HQ:[/b] Addressed an issue that prevented players from entering the Garrahan Mining Headquarters from the Garrahan Mining Lobby. 
[*][b]Nuka-World on Tour:[/b] Lady G's stall is now in its proper place. 
[/list]
[h5] Events[/h5]
[list]
[*][b]Distinguished Guests:[/b] Players will now receive proper rewards for each completion stage of this event. 
[*][b]Feed the People[/b] : Food canisters will no longer despawn during Feed the People when a player enters the loading dock. 
[*][b]Nuka-World on Tour:[/b] All Nuka-World on Tour Public Events now correctly drop Legendary Cores upon event completion. 
[*][b]Nuka-World on Tour:[/b]"What Slept Beneath" now grants the correct amount of XP. 
[*][b]Nuka-World on Tour:[/b]"Seismic Activity" now properly grants Ultracite Scrap as an event reward. 
[*][b]Nuka-World on Tour:[/b] The "Deposit Buckaroos" counter in Most Wanted now displays the number of Buckaroos needed instead of using a progress bar. 
[/list]
[h5] Items[/h5]
[list]
[*][b]Junk[/b] : Gold Table Spoons now provide gold instead of silver when scrapped. 
[*][b]Gunpowder:[/b] Gunpowder is now classified as a junk/scrap item. 
[*][b]Nuka-Cola:[/b] Nuka-Grape now shows the correct value of rads removed after drinking. 
[*][b]Power Armor:[/b] The T-65 right arm now correctly requires Aluminum for crafting, to match the left arm. 
[*][b]RadAway Diluted:[/b] Reduced the debuff timer from 2 hours to 7 minutes to be more aligned with RadAway, which has a 15-minute debuff timer. 
[*][b]Sunshine Oil:[/b] Adjusted the Sunshine Oil to use the correct Damage Resistance effect. The Damage Reduction now also is increased by the Herbivore mutation. 
[/list]
[h5] Localization[/h5]
[list]
[*][b]Localization:[/b] Various Localization Fixes.
[/list]
[h5] Perks[/h5]
[list]
[*][b]Quack Surgeon:[/b] Mire Magic Moonshine and Vintage Mire Magic Moonshine now work with the Quack Surgeon Perk. 
[*][b]Perk Sharing:[/b] Added a gameplay setting to allow players to reject Shared Perks from Team Members. 
[/list]
[h5] Quests[/h5]
[list]
[*][b]Disarming Discovery:[/b] Dagger will no longer become hostile to the player prematurely. 
[*][b]Flavors of Mayhem:[/b] Players will no longer receive Syringer ammo upon relog. 
[/list]

notes.title: Fallout 76 Nuka-World on Tour Update Notes – December 6, 2022
notes.content:
Our latest update for Fallout 76 launches today, and it’s bringing Nuka-World to Appalachia with our Nuka-World on Tour update! It also includes Fallout 76 Season 11, new rewards, gameplay improvements, and more. Read on for a full list of patch notes for today’s update. 

[h5=name]Or click here to jump right to the patch notes.[/h5]

[hr][/hr]

[h3] Update Version 1.7.2.9 [/h3]

Check the download sizes below for today’s patch on your platform of choice: 
[list]
[*][b]PC (Steam):[/b] 16 GB 
[*][b]PC (Microsoft Store):[/b] 25.1GB 
[*][b]PlayStation:[/b] 22.9 GB 
[*][b]Xbox:[/b] 25.1 GB 
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h3] Nuka-World on Tour [/h3]
The Nuka-World on Tour traveling road show has finished unpacking their tents, stocked the Nukacade with rewards, and is ready for visitors! Venture to the fairgrounds West of Lake Reynolds in the Ash Heap to play three brand-new public events, earn rewards in the Nuka-Cade, and unleash the largest region boss we’ve implemented into Fallout 76 to date; The Ultracite Titan! 

[h4] New Public Events [/h4]
[list]
[*][b]Spin the Wheel:[/b] Join Bottle and Cappy in the Big Top Tent to become a contestant during the “Spin the Wheel” gameshow, where anything is possible! The rules are simple: Press the button to spin the giant wheel inside the Big Top Tent and then take on any challenge it selects. Defend our beloved mascots from unique combinations of enemy creatures, go Brahmin tipping, dodge exploding “Fragstags,” and more! Contestants who survive five rounds will walk away with fabulous prizes! 

[*][b]Most Wanted:[/b] Mosey on over to Wild West Town, where Gunther is putting on a rootin’ tootin’ good time during his Wild West Show. All he needs to set the stage is a few hotshot gunslingers, like you, to perform as Outlaws. Once the event begins, fleece the town and its citizens of their belongings, and stash any ill-gotten valuables into your Getaway Wagon. Then, prepare to defend your haul against the long, robotic arm of the Law. Topple the Sherriff during the ensuing shootout, and you will be able to ride off into the sunset with some loot. 

[*][b]Tunnel of Love:[/b] This romantic ride is the perfect attraction for lovestruck couples who are looking for a little quality time together amid the flurry of lights and sounds at the carnival. At least it will be. Once it’s ready. Mr. Lovely just needs a few helping hands to make repairs and to finish decorating the Tunnel of Love before it can whisk swooning sweethearts into a land of enchantment. Don’t worry, trekking into the depths of a mine shaft to hang some heart-shaped décor should be a safe and speedy venture for a sturdy explorer such as yourself. After all, it has been abandoned for quite some time. . . 
[/list]
[b]Please note:[/b] For the first four weeks of this Update, Nuka-World on Tour Public Events will have priority when new Public Events appear and will start at the top of the hour. 

[h4] Win prizes at the Nuka-Cade! [/h4]
That’s not all that’s arriving with the tour! Grab a fistful of Caps and head to the Nuka-Cade to try your hand at carnival games that are sure to be fun for the whole family! It’s got all your favorites, like “Bandit Roundup,” “Nuka Zapper Race,” and “Whack-A-Commie.” We’re also proud to introduce “Bottle Blaster,” which will truly test your might. As you play, you will earn Nuka-Cade points, which you can redeem to get exciting prizes. 

[h4] New Region Boss: The Ultracite Titan [/h4]
Pete has been hard at work trying to repair the air filters throughout the carnival, but the parts he needs are scattered deep within the earth in an abandoned mineshaft. He’s also convinced that a massive creature has made its home down there. Pete is hoping that some keen Dwellers can investigate, and then launch an attack that’s powerful enough to blast the fiend to smithereens from afar. However, those who undertake this dangerous task should keep in mind that if the monster survives, then a direct confrontation with the beast will be unavoidable. 

[hr][/hr]
[h3] Season 11: Nuka-World [/h3]
Nuka-World isn’t limited to just the travelling roadshow, with today’s update we have a brand-new Nuka-Cola themed season to quench your thirst! Tour around Nuka-World, visiting iconic locations such as Dry Rock Gulch, Safari Adventure, and more. Complete Daily and Weekly Challenges to earn Score, and unlock new items such as Sheepsquatch Power Armor Paints, C.A.M.P. items, consumables, a new Lite Ally and more! 

[hr][/hr]
[h3] New Feature: Fallout 1st Ammo Storage Box[/h3]
Fallout 1st members will receive a new membership feature: the Ammo Storage Box! The Ammo Storage Box works similarly to the Scrap Box already included with your Fallout 1st membership, offering unlimited space to store all your excess munitions, with the exception of Plasma Core and Fusion Cores.  

This new feature is a complimentary additional benefit to Fallout 1st memberships. Learn all the benefits of becoming a Fallout 1st member [url=https://fallout.bethesda.net/en/fallout1st]here[/url].

[hr][/hr]

[h3] Build like never before with the Free Cam  [/h3]

Free cam is a new quality-of-life feature that we're introducing to Fallout 76. When inside build mode, select X on keyboard, or Start on controller to enter Free cam mode. In this mode, the camera detaches from your character, allowing you to freely build at new heights, pan through walls, doors, windows, and floors. 

[hr][/hr]
[h3] Additional Design Changes & Improvements [/h3]

[h4] Weapon Changes [/h4]
Players who tried out Nuka-World on Tour while it was on the Public Test Server are aware that we originally planned to release a new system that combats illegal attachment combinations to weapons that violate the EULA. We need a bit more time to implement this than originally projected, and as a result [b]we will not be releasing this system with today’s update.[/b]  

As we continue to work on it, we will keep you up to date on its arrival in a future Inside the Vault. 

[hr][/hr]
[url=#name][h3] Bug Fixes & Improvements [/h3][/url]

[h5] Art [/h5]
[list]
[*][b]Armor Paints:[/b] Applying the Raiderish paint now correctly updates the item name. 
[*][b]Headwear:[/b] Fixed various instances where facial hair would be removed when equipping the Trench Runner Headwear. 
[*][b]Previews:[/b] Various adjustments to item previews in the build menu.

[*][b]Power Armor:[/b] The Wasteland Knight Power Armor paint no longer makes the player’s head appear to be floating.

[*][b]Slocum’s Joe Vending Machine:[/b] Fixed an audio issue with the Slocum’s Joe Vending Machine when more than one are placed. 
[*][b]Tipsy-Tom Vending Machine:[/b] Fixed an issue causing animations to break when fast traveling away from the Tipsy Tom Vending Machine.

[*][b]Bucket List:[/b] Ansel Abrahams corpse will no longer spawn at the Whitespring. 
[*][b]Campfire Tales:[/b] Scout Leader Penny now says appropriate voice lines if interacted with during the boss sequence. 
[*][b]Disarming Discovery:[/b] Addressed an issue causing Dagger’s body to occasionally not have the key. 
[*][b]Disarming Discovery:[/b] Dagger will no longer appear in her Throne Room until players have agreed to investigate Dagger’s Den. 
[*][b]Distinguished Guests:[/b] Robot waiters now have specific quest targets on them when the player gets within reasonable distance. 
[*][b]Dogwood Die Off:[/b] Players can now travel to fertilizer locations without exiting the event. 
[*][b]Here to Stay:[/b] Players with the Cannibal perk equipped will no longer eat the bodies of the settlers at Aubrie’s Camp before searching them. 
[*][b]Hide and Seek and Destroy:[/b] Fixed an issue allowing the player to receive a duplicate keycard. 
[*][b]Hunter for Hire:[/b] Liebowitz will no longer take a Deathclaw Egg from the player after being intimidated.

[*][b]Feed the People:[/b] Food canister quest items will no longer have weight and will be cleaned up properly upon event completion. 
[*][b]Moonshine Jamboree:[/b] Enemy Waves 2 and 3 now correctly play their unique combat music. 
[*][b]Moonshine Jamboree:[/b] Locally looting Jesus Sunday’s Holotape now correctly progresses the quest. 
[*][b]One Violent Night:[/b] Addressed an issue where some melee weapon swings would not count correctly towards the quest objectives. 
[*][b]Teatime:[/b] Players who join late will now correctly hear Sweetwater’s announcements throughout the event. [/list]

[h5] Expeditions [/h5]
[list]
[*][b]Audio:[/b] Addressed an issue causing the Fanatic Manhunter’s minigun sound effects to continue after death. 
[*][b]Dog Ex Machina:[/b] The Rusty Protectron will no longer walk into the Desperate Refugee when returning. 
[*][b]From Ashes to Fire:[/b] Optional objective to rescue the helpless survivors will no longer re-appear on re-entering the mission after it’s been failed once. 
[*][b]From Ashes to Fire:[/b] Player can no longer kill the Fanatic Foreman outside of his intended combat phase. 
[*][b]Gameplay:[/b] Addressed an issue that could cause players to become control locked while joining a teammates Expedition from the map. 
[*][b]Teams:[/b] Players will now be kicked out of Expeditions Instances when the leader leaves the team. 
[*][b]Worlds:[/b] Fallout Worlds custom Weather settings now correctly apply to Expeditions. 
[*][b]UI:[/b] Addressed an issue causing Legendary Rewards Fanfare to occasionally remain on the screen longer than intended. 
[*][b]UI:[/b] Addressed an issue causing the rewards screen to not display Legendary Rewards. 
[*][b]UI:[/b] Fixed an issue that could cause sludge effects to appear at the Expedition starting point.

[h5]General[/h5]

Communist Commander Hat, Communist Militant Hat, Hooded Rags, Insurgent Hat, Mummy Mask, Treasure Hunter Outfit Hat, Vault Survivor Hood, Wrapped Cap.

notes.title: Fallout 76 update finally nerfs the MMO's most broken weapons
notes.content:
After four years, a Fallout 76 update is finally removing the most notoriously broken weapons in the Bethesda RPG game. While having overpowered weapons and abilities can be extremely fun in a single-player game such as Skyrim or Fallout 4, the nature of Fallout 76 as a multiplayer game means that other players have to deal with the ramifications of anyone who chooses to use one of the most broken Fallout 76 guns.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Fallout 76 Update Notes – October 25, 2022
notes.content:
Our latest update for Fallout 76 brings a variety of new bug fixes and improvements to the game. Read on to catch all the details.

Download size: 3.3 GB 
---

notes.title: Celebrate 25 Years of Fallout All Month Long
notes.content:
In October of 1997, players first encountered Fallout’s post-nuclear world and its memorable characters, irradiated monstrosities, impactful conversations and stark reminders that war…war never changes.

25 years later, the Fallout series is a best-selling franchise that not only helped define PC role-playing games and spawned entries across multiple console generations, but also has made its way to tabletop games and even an upcoming television series. Join us as we ring in a milestone year for Fallout throughout the entire month of October!

[h2]A MONTH-LONG CELEBRATION[/h2]
That’s right, we’re not just celebrating Fallout’s birthday, we’re celebrating Fallout’s birth*month*. Each week in October, you can visit [url=https://fallout.bethesda.net/en/fallout25th]fallout25th.com[/url] to learn what we’ve got planned for that week’s festivities. From sales and giveaways to special features and community content, there’ll be lots to check out celebrating Fallout’s 25th anniversary!

Speaking of which, don’t forget to join the party on social media. Use the hashtag **#Fallout25** and be sure to follow our official [url=https://twitter.com/Fallout]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/fallout/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/Fallout]Facebook[/url] accounts to see what the Fallout community is cooking up. We’re also excited to announce that a Twitter Community and dedicated chat on the official Fallout Discord channel so you can celebrate right with your fellow fans! Stay tuned to our social media channels for more information.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/rporu91m20dc/2Wypzr140eCdVvDqQUab48/ca7c6333dd702e4ec6db7f38d396104c/F76_Pitt_Key_Art_in-body.png[/img]
[h3]FALLOUT 76 FREE PLAY WEEK[/h3]
Haven’t taken a dive into Fallout 76? Explore post-nuclear Appalachia (and, following the game’s recent Expeditions update, [url=https://fallout.bethesda.net/en/article/7iswEuZf5CujgLYGg08OsN/fallout-76-expeditions-the-pitt-update-live]The Pitt [/url]with your friends at no additional charge during Fallout 76’s Free Play  Week, starting [b]October 4[/b] to [b]October 11[/b].

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/rporu91m20dc/73TAPqOymGcKsQ0VHJga92/47b57f57e2725d75eee24cebdb12f91c/F25_PALS_in-body.png[/img]
[h3]FACTION QUIZ[/h3]
There are numerous groups, organizations, cults and plain ol’ gangs that call their slice of Fallout’s world home. That’s why we developed the [url=https://fallout.bethesda.net/en/fallout25th/]Post-Apocalyptic Loyalty Simulator[/url], or P.A.L.S., questionnaire  to help you find which post-nuclear faction suits you. Find where you belong in Fallout and share with your friends!

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/rporu91m20dc/VF0ElVwhvra28GJe0CaTt/5f387d21cab57d8e2bb217ab109aa86c/F25_Shelter_in-body.png[/img][h3]A NEW UPDATE COMES TO FALLOUT SHELTER![/h3]
Overseers rejoice: In celebration of Fallout’s 25th anniversary, we’re adding new content to Fallout Shelter for the first time in over four years! Take on an alien threat in an all-new quest line featuring new enemies, take up arms with new weapons, recruit new Dwellers and decorate your Vault with a new celebration room theme. We’ll have more to show off when the updates launches soon, so stay tuned!

This month will be a blast for any Fallout fan – one you won’t need a Vault to hide from – and we look forward to seeing you all emerge during our 25th anniversary celebration!

notes.title: ENTER THE PITT: FALLOUT 76’S EXPEDITIONS UPDATE IS LIVE!
notes.content:
Vault dwellers, it’s time to venture into new territory. Fallout 76’s Expeditions update is now live, letting players leave the borders of Appalachia to take on the trails that await in…The Pitt.
[previewyoutube=xk97bZ2ZzqE;full][/previewyoutube]
Explore post-nuclear Pittsburgh, back from its fan-favorite debut in Fallout 3. Intervene in a conflict between the local Union faction and besieging Fanatics. Fight off perilous threats such as deadly Trogs and should you survive the whole ordeal, be handsomely rewarded in loot.

Find out more [url=https://fallout.bethesda.net/en/article/7iswEuZf5CujgLYGg08OsN/fallout-76-expeditions-the-pitt-update-live]by visiting Fallout.com[/url]!

notes.title: Fallout 76: The Pitt Update Notes – September 13, 2022
notes.content:
Our latest update for Fallout 76 launches today, and it brings the Expeditions system to Fallout 76, which will take you beyond Appalachia’s borders for the very first time as you embark on Missions to The Pitt! It also introduces Fallout 76 Season 10, and a slate of new rank-up rewards, as well as a new wave of gameplay improvements and bug fixes.

--- 
[h2]Update Highlights[/h2] [list]
[*] [b]Responders, Reborn[/b]: Head to “The Whitespring Refuge” inside The Whitespring Resort to meet a new generation of Responders. They’re working hard to lend aid to all who are in need, both at home in Appalachia, and in distant settlements using their Vertibird.
[*] [b]Charge Up & Take Flight[/b]: Even the Responders could use a helping hand. Complete new Daily Quests at The Whitespring Refuge to earn their trust and to charge up the Vertibird’s Ultracite Battery. 
[*] [b]Head into The Pitt[/b]: Fire up the Vertibird and use it to lead Expeditions to The Pitt, where you can take on our first two Missions, “Union Dues” and “From Ashes to Fire.” Lend your firepower to the industrious Union, who have been embroiled in a battle against the treacherous Fanatic Raiders.
[*] [b]Earn Stamps & Claim Rewards[/b]: Complete Missions in The Pitt to earn Legendary Weapons and Armor, Legendary Modules, in-game currencies, and more. You’ll also receive Stamps based on your performance, which you can use to buy specific rewards in The Whitespring Refuge.
[*] [b]Visit “The City of Steel” in Season 10![/b] Earn S.C.O.R.E. to rank-up and claim a host of new rewards, including the Auto Axe and Union Power Armor, on the Fallout 76 Season 10 Scoreboard, “Red Rocket ‘Across America’ Presents: The City of Steel.” [/list]
--- 
[h2]Update Version 1.7.0.23[/h2]
Download Size: 23.5 GB
--- 
[h2]Introducing: Expeditions & The Pitt[/h2]
We’re introducing the Expeditions system, which will take you and up to three other teammates beyond the reaches of Appalachia for the first time in order to complete challenging and repeatable Missions. While anyone can participate in an Expedition, we currently recommend reaching level 50+ for the best experience.
[h3]The Responders are Back![/h3]
With more and more people returning to Appalachia, some have discovered the Responders of days past and decided to take up their mantle and mission to provide aid to anyone in need. This new generation of Responders have set up a base of operations inside The Whitespring Resort, and named it “The Whitespring Refuge.” 

Recently, the Responders have managed to find and restore a Vertibird. With your help, they are hoping to use it to expand their efforts to distant settlements across the Wasteland. [list]
[*] Visit The Whitespring Refuge to start the “Responders Reborn” quest, which will introduce you to many of the noble souls who make up the new Responders.
[*] Along the way, you will learn about the Responders’ goals, earn their trust, and gain access to lead Expeditions using their Vertibird.[/list]
[h3]Charge Up & Take Flight[/h3]
To kick off an Expedition, you will need to make the Vertibird flight-ready by charging its Ultracite Battery Cell (Ultracell). Unfortunately, Ultracell charge is in short supply, and the Responders keep theirs tightly rationed. 
After completing the “Responders Reborn” quest, you can visit the Whitespring Refuge every day to automatically start 3 different Refuge Daily Quests. [list]
[*] In exchange for your help, the Responders will grant you 25% Ultracell Charge for completing certain Refuge Daily Quests, and 50% charge for others.
[*] Complete all 3 of your quests for the day, and you will earn enough to charge the Vertibird’s battery up to 100%, which will enable you to lead an Expedition. [/list]
You can hold a maximum of 100% Ultracell Charge at any given time, and all of it will be consumed when you start a new Expedition. [list]
[*] Visit the Collections tab in the Pip-Boy to view how much Ultracell Charge you have at any given time. [i]Please Note: You can currently complete Refuge Dailies and lead an Expedition once per day. However, you can join Expeditions led by others as often as you would like.[/i]  
[*] We’ve added an “Expeditions” Team to the Public Teams list, which provides bonus XP for completing Expeditions and will help you find teammates more easily. [/list]
[h3]Embark On Missions to The Pitt[/h3]
A recent arrival to The Whitespring Refuge alerted the Responders to the dire situation in a city known as “The Pitt.” There, members of the Union are under siege by a vicious band of Fanatic Raiders, who are working to expand their “territory” by any means necessary.
Our first two Missions, “Union Dues” and “From Ashes to Fire” will take you deep into the heart of the conflict in The Pitt to bolster the Union’s efforts, save their people from the Raiders’ cruelty, and sabotage the Fanatics’ plans at every turn. [list]
[*] [b]Union Dues[/b]: Fanatic Raiders have overtaken The Foundry, a steel mill that the Union had been using as a stronghold and home base. As you touch down in The Pitt, you will rendezvous with Hex, a leader of one of the Union Local chapters. Hex will share details with you about how to sabotage the Fanatics’ operations, so the Union can take steps toward reclaiming the Foundry.
[*] [b]From Ashes to Fire[/b]: Get in contact with Danilo, who will send you on a rescue mission to Sanctum. There, ruthless Fanatics have imprisoned and enslaved many members of the Union. Prepare an escape path for captive Union members, free as many of them as you can, and then raise mayhem within Sanctum to hit the Fanatics where it hurts. [/list]
Once you’ve fully charged the Vertibird’s battery, open the Map, select the Expeditions icon, and move left or right to choose which Mission you’d like to start.
As you play through a Mission, you will receive 3 randomized objectives, which will help keep your experiences feeling fresh from one playthrough to the next. [list]
[*] In addition, you will receive optional objectives that you can complete along the way.
[*] The more optional objectives you and your teammates complete, the better your rewards will be at the end of the Mission. [/list]
Don’t worry if you need to step away from the game in the middle of a Mission, because the objectives are checkpointed. Even if you close the game, you will be able to pick up where you left off the next time you log in. 
[h3]Reap Your Rewards[/h3]
Every time you finish a Mission, you will earn up to 5 legendary items based on how many primary and optional objectives you and your team completed. [list]
[*] You will also receive one Legendary Module, with a chance to earn a second, some Legendary Scrips or Treasury Notes, loot, and XP. [/list]
Once per week, you will earn a random item from the pool of rare Expeditions-themed rewards by completing all optional objectives during a Mission. [i]Please Note: Due to an issue discovered just before patch day, the weekly rare reward will not be available initially following today’s maintenance. We plan to hotfix this issue on Thursday, September 15, so that players can still earn their rare reward for this week. All other Mission rewards, like currencies, legendary items, and Modules, can still be earned today as normal.[/i] [list]
[*] Rare rewards can include mods for the Auto Axe and Union Power Armor, new outfits, Pitt-themed furnishings for your C.A.M.P., and more!
[*] You will not earn duplicate items from the rare Expeditions reward pool. Once you have learned the Plan for one of these rewards, it can no longer drop as your weekly reward for completing a Mission.
[*] The weekly rare Expedition reward timer will reset for all players at 12:00 p.m. ET every Tuesday. [/list]
With the arrival of Expeditions, were also introducing a new in-game currency, called “Stamps.” [list]
[*] All Expedition participants will earn Stamps every time they complete a Mission, and completing optional objectives will increase the number of Stamps they receive.
[*] The Expedition Leader will earn a few extra Stamps due the effort required to complete Refuge Daily Quests and charge up the Vertibird’s battery.
[*] Bring your Stamps to Giuseppe, a new vendor inside The Whitespring Refuge to exchange them for specific rare Expeditions rewards that you’d like to add to your collection. [/list]
--- 
[h2]Take A Road Trip to “The City of Steel” During Season 10[/h2]
Here’s what’s headed your way during Fallout 76 Season 10, which begins today:
[h3]New Scoreboard: The City of Steel[/h3]
Ride shotgun alongside Red Rocket for a road trip to experience the sights and sounds of sterling Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania! Take in breathtaking views of the city’s towering skyline, get acquainted with its friendly and hard-working citizens, and explore its rich history at the center of U.S. steel production. Do all this, and more, as you rank up on the all-new Fallout 76 Season 10 Scoreboard: “Red Rocket ‘Across America’ Presents: The City of Steel”. [list]
[*] [b]A Host of New Rewards[/b]: As you progress during your Season journey, you will unlock new paints for your weapons, armor, and Power Armor, Pitt-themed amenities for your C.A.M.P., outfits, cosmetics, consumables, in-game currencies, and more!
[*] [b]Add to Your Stamp Collection[/b]: Several ranks throughout the Scoreboard feature our new in-game currency, Stamps. Put a few extra Stamps into your pocket by ranking up, and then head to Giuseppe at The Whitespring Refuge to exchange them for rare item plans. [/list]
[h3]Unlock New Gear as You Rank Up[/h3]
For the first time ever, you will unlock the ability to craft brand new items, like weapons and Power Armor, as you rank up on The City of Steel Scoreboard. Here are the new items that are up for grabs this Season: [list]
[*] [b]Auto Axe[/b]: In the right hands, the industrious Auto Axe is a workhorse that can chew through any obstacle in your path. With a little know-how and elbow grease, you can modify it to dish out poison, electrical, or fire damage.
[*] [b]Union Power Armor[/b]: Perfect for your forays into The Pitt, you will receive +150 Poison Resistance and +75 Carry Weight bonuses whenever you’re wearing a full set of Union Power Armor.
[*] During Season 10, the Auto Axe and Union Power Armor can only be earned by ranking up on the Scoreboard. Once Season 10 concludes, we plan to add them to Giuseppe’s inventory. That way players who miss them this Season will still be able to unlock them in the future using Stamps. [/list]
Learn more about Fallout 76 Season 10 and check out our latest Community Calendar by heading to the [url=https://fallout.bethesda.net/en/seasons]Seasons page on Fallout.com[/url].
--- 
[h2]Additional Design Changes & Improvements[/h2]
[h3]Appalachia[/h3]
[b]Fast Travel:[/b] For certain points of interest, like The Whitespring Resort, The Rusty Pick, The Crater, Foundation, or Fort Atlas, players can now decide whether to Fast Travel directly inside that location, or to its exterior. [list]
[*] Additionally, a new “Whitespring North Entrance” Fast Travel point has been added to The Whitespring Resort. Players can discover it on foot, and then use it to travel directly inside The Whitespring Mall. [/list]
[b]Purveyor Murmrgh[/b]: Players can now purchase up to 100 Legendary Modules and up to 500 Vault Steel at once from Purveyor Murmrgh.
[b]The Whitespring Resort[/b]: A Legendary Exchange Machine and a Gold Press Machine are now available inside of Artisan’s Corner in the Whitespring mall.
[h3]Items[/h3]
[b]Automatic Melee Weapons:[/b] Legendary Versions of auto-melee weapons, like the Chainsaw, Ripper, Drill, etc., can now be crafted at Weapons Workbenches, and they can drop as legendary loot from Events, Quests, and Legendary Enemies.
[h3]Starting Gear[/h3]
With today’s update, we have included some adjustments to the starting experience for Dwellers who are taking their first steps out of Vault 76. The following changes should help players feel more prepared as they begin their journeys in Appalachia.

New Dwellers will now receive the following items as they exit Vault 76: [list]
[*] 1x 10mm Pistol with 200+ 10mm ammo
[*] 1x Combat Knife
[*] 1x Light Leather Torso Armor
[*] 1x Small Backpack (Players will still need to find and learn the Plan in order to craft a Small Backpack.)
[*] A variety of consumables, including: Stimpaks, RadAway, Antibiotics, food and water, a Vault-Tec Supply Package, and Scrap and Repair Kits. [/list]
In addition, they will now receive the “Vault Fed” buff, which will prevent hunger and thirst from increasing for 2 hours.
Finally, the resistances and damage for many creatures in the Level 1 – 15 range have been reduced, which should help smooth out early combat.
--- 
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]Art[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Beds[/b]: Fixed an issue on consoles that could prevent the Alien Stasis Chamber’s swirling blue visual effects from appearing while it is in use.
[*] [b]Power Armor[/b]: The player’s arms no longer clip when entering or exiting a set of Power Armor.
[*] [b]Ranged Weapons[/b]: The Dastardly Duo Paint can now be applied to the unique legendary Double-Barrel Shotgun, “Salt of the Earth.” [/list]
[h3]C.A.M.P.s & Workshops[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Allies[/b]: C.A.M.P. objects can no longer be placed on top of Xerxo’s Spaceship.
[*] [b]Chairs[/b]: Players can now sit on Modular Sofas.
[*] [b]Doors[/b]: The Chain-Link Door now plays the correct sound and visual effects when destroyed.
[*] [b]Exploit[/b]: Addressed an exploit that could allow the player to have two active C.A.M.P.s at once.
[*] [b]Floors[/b]: Corrected a pathing issue affecting the Upper Floor variant of the Destroyed Tile Floor.
[*] [b]Floor Décor[/b]: Different types of Radiation Dummies now share the same row in the build menu’s Floor Décor category, and players can move left or right to select between them.
[*] [b]Floor Décor[/b]: The crafting requirements for the Floating Face Flagon are now consistent in both the C.A.M.P. build menu and the Tinker’s Workbench.
[*] [b]Misc. Structures[/b]: When the Firewatch Tower is connected to power, lights placed on the Tower’s upper beams now receive power correctly.
[*] [b]Misc. Structures[/b]: C.A.M.P. Allies and Collectrons, can now correctly walk on the roof of the Destroyed Trailer.
[*] [b]Misc. Structures[/b]: Players can now shoot and throw grenades through gaps in the walls of the Destroyed Trailer when it is in a destroyed state.
[*] [b]Vendors[/b]: Tipsy Tom Vending Machine variants now animate correctly after being repaired.
[*] [b]Wallpapers[/b]: Wall Décor items no longer sink into walls that have the Order of Mystery Wallpaper applied.
[*] [b]Wallpapers[/b]: Flat Wall Décor, like posters, paintings, pennants, Scoreboards, and etc., no longer sink into walls that have Wallpaper applied.
[*] [b]Wallpapers[/b]: The Stripes, Haunted House, and Order of Mystery Wallpapers are now oriented correctly when applied to triangle walls.
[*] [b]Workbenches[/b]: Fixed an issue in which Tinker’s Workbenches in players’ C.A.M.P.s could sometimes become unusable and unmovable. [/list]
[h3]Challenges[/h3] [list]
[*][b] Daily[/b]: Crafting or scrapping Alien Blasters and V.A.T.S. Unknown now correctly progresses the “Craft or Scrap a Ranged Weapon” Daily Challenge.
[*] [b]Daily[/b]: Using a Repair Kit to repair an item that is inside the player’s Stash now correctly progresses the “Repair Armor, Weapons, or Power Armor” Daily Challenge.
[*] [b]Weekly[/b]: Crafting and scrapping headwear and underarmors now correctly progresses the “Craft or Scrap Clothing, Armor, or Weapons” Weekly Challenge.
[*] [b]Weekly[/b]: Fixed an issue that caused Treasure Hunter Mole Miners and Prime Mole Rats to progress the “Kill a Glowing Creature” Weekly Challenge. [/list]
[h3]Combat[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Melee Enemies[/b]: Continuously circling around certain enemies, like Cave Crickets, Wolves, and Mr. Handy Bots, no longer prevents them from attacking the player. [/list]
[h3]Enemies[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Bloodbugs[/b]: On death, Bloodbugs now have a chance to drop Bloodbug Meat as loot.
[*] [b]Dogs[/b]: Dog-type enemies, like Mongrels and Wolves, can now run after attacking the player instead of always walking. [/list]
[h3]Events & Quests [/h3] [list]
[*] [b]A Colossal Problem[/b]: Fixed an issue that could temporarily block player movement through the tunnel when attempting to escape Monongah Mine.
[*] [b]Ally[/b]: Patently False: Fixed an issue in which players were directed to collect an incorrect item during the quest.
[*] [b]An Organic Solution[/b]: The quest marker on Ella Ames’s body is now correctly removed after looting “Ella’s Research.”
[*] [b]An Ounce of Prevention[/b]: The optional objective to “Enter Charleston Trainyard's main gate” can now be completed again after logging out and back in.
[*] [b]AWOL Armaments[/b]: Interacting with Sergeant Gutsy while it is already speaking no longer interrupts its dialogue or causes it to replay.
[*] [b]Bots on Parade[/b]: All enemies during the event are now hostile to the player by default, and can be targeted in VATS.
[*] [b]Distinguished Guests[/b]: Fixed an issue that sometimes caused the Waiter Bots to leave the function room after players send them back to work.
[*] [b]Heart of the Swamp[/b]: Objectives now appear correctly in the quest tracker if the Grafton Monster spawns as the boss.
[*] [b]Irrational Fear[/b]: Enemies that spawn during the event can now target and deal damage to Beckham.
[*] [b]Line in the Sand[/b]: Quest targets no longer appear on Scorchbeasts that spawn during the event.
[*] [b]Lode Bearing[/b]: Event failure fanfare now correctly appears if players do not open the mine before the timer expires.
[*] [b]Miner Miracles[/b]: The Power Armor registration console is now only useable when players have reached the appropriate stage of the quest.
[*] [b]Misc.[/b]: Reuben’s Safe Key is now correctly removed from the player’s inventory after using it to unlock Mr. Gill’s Safe inside the Shelters Claim Center.
[*] [b]Missing Persons[/b]: Scribe Valdez’s dialogue near the end of the quest now correctly matches the player’s current quest progress.
[*] [b]One Violent Night[/b]: Event failure fanfare now correctly appears when players do not complete the objectives before the timer expires.
[*] [b]One Violent Night[/b]: The optional objective to “Defeat the Nightstalker Bare-Handed” can now be completed while unarmed, as well as while unarmed in Power Armor.
[*] [b]Path to Enlightenment[/b]: The Wise Mothman now correctly appears in front of Landview Lighthouse after completing the event.
[*] [b]Pet Peeve[/b]: Noodles can no longer spawn as Diseased or Glowing, and will not turn hostile when attacked by the player.
[*] [b]Radiation Rumble[/b]: Marion Copeland will now ignore combat until players initiate the event and enemies start spawning.
[*] [b]Radiation Rumble[/b]: Marion Copeland now uses a consistent weapon during the event, instead of sometimes swapping to unarmed combat.
[*] [b]Supplying Demands[/b]: Paladin Rahmani will no longer bring up a trade deal if the player did not secure one during the quest.
[*] [b]Supplying Demands[/b]: The objective to “Negotiate a deal with Foundation” no longer completes before the player has confirmed the deal with Gloria.
[*] [b]Thrill of the Grill[/b]: Carrots, which are needed for the quest’s optional objective, can now spawn at Graninger Farm, Smith Farm, and Becker Farm in the Toxic Valley.
[*] [b]Test Your Metal[/b]: Addressed an issue in which Grimm Bots could clip through the western wall of the Rust Eagle Arena and leave the event area.
[*] [b]Test Your Metal[/b]: The Golden Eyebot no longer occasionally becomes stuck when trying to enter or exit the Rust Eagle Arena.
[*] [b]Treasure Unknown[/b]: The “Filtcher Farm Interview” Holotape is no longer retains its quest item status after completing the quest.
[*] [b]Wayward Souls[/b]: Fixed an issue where Duchess would look straight ahead instead of at the player after handing them a drink. [/list]
[h3]Items[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Allies[/b]: Plans for Katherine Swan and Xerxo are now visible in Samuel’s inventory and can be purchased using Gold Bullion by players who have not yet learned them.
[*] [b]Ammo[/b]: Reduced the weight and crafting requirements for Alien Blaster Rounds so that they now match Fusion Cells.
[*] [b]Armor[/b]: Atomic Camo, Free States, and Red Viper Paints can now be applied to Urban Scout Armor.
[*] [b]Lunchboxes[/b]: Lunchbox effects now trigger correctly for nearby players, even if they aren’t within line of sight of the Lunchbox owner.
[*] [b]Mods[/b]: The "Extra Limb Damage" weapon Mod effect now correctly adds +25% increased damage to limbs, and the "Extra Chance to Cripple" weapon Mod effect now correctly adds +20% chance to instantly cripple.
[*] [b]ProSnap Deluxe[/b]: The ProSnap Deluxe Camera now registers targets more consistently when zoomed in and while the player is moving.
[*] [b]Weapons[/b]: The Dual Bar Mod for the Chainsaw now correctly increases the weapon’s damage. [i]Please note: We are aware of a related visual issue in which the damage stat in the crafting menu may not reflect bonus damage from the Dual Bar and other Chainsaw mods.[/i]
[*] [b]Weapons[/b]: Fixed an issue that caused charging weapons to deal less damage than intended when they were not fully-charged.
[*] [b]Weapons[/b]: The Gauss Shotgun now counts as an energy weapon in addition to its other weapon types, and it correctly benefits from Perk Cards and other buffs that affect energy weapons.
[*] [b]Weapons[/b]: Short and Long Barrel Mods for the Flamer no longer conflict with range reductions applied by Nozzle Mods.
[*] [b]Weapons[/b]: Receiver Mods that increase the Lever Action Rifle’s fire rate now function as intended.
[*] [b]Weapons[/b]: The Hunting Rifle’s Refined .50 Receiver Mod now correctly applies more bonus damage to the weapon than the normal .50 Receiver Mod.
[*] [b]Weapons[/b]: 10mm SMGs with the Tweaked Automatic Receiver and Gamma Guns with the Signal Repeater Mod are now correctly affected by the Guerilla Perk Card.
[*] [b]Weapons[/b]: The Gyro Compensating Lens Mod for Laser Guns now correctly provides superior hip fire accuracy.
[*] [b]Weapons[/b]: The “Mods Unlocked” portion of the crafting menu now correctly displays a total of 65 available Mods for the Pipe Gun, instead of 66.
[*] [b]Weapons[/b]: The Gatling Laser, Gatling Plasma, and Ultracite Gatling Laser can no longer spawn with the “Quad” Legendary attribute. [/list]
[h3]Perk Cards[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Electric Absorption[/b]: The description of the Electric Absorption Legendary Perk Card now correctly communicates that it heals the player in addition to its other effects.
[*] [b]Glow Sight[/b]: The Glow Sight Perk Card now correctly applies bonus damage to Glowing Wendigo Spawns during the “A Colossal Problem” Public Event. [/list]
[h3]User Interface[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Character Levels[/b]: Character levels that are four and five digits long now display correctly on the Map, as well as in the Social, Team, and Play menus.
[*] [b]Crafting[/b]: On PC, the bulk crafting slider now closes correctly after using the crafting menu buttons at the bottom of the screen.
[*] [b]Loading Screens[/b]: Event details now display correctly on loading screens when joining a Public Event.
[*] [b]Main Menu[/b]: Fixed an issue that could cause the in-game “Message of the Day” and News Screen to appear blank for those who play Fallout 76 on consoles.
[*] [b]Map[/b]: Fixed an issue that could cause elements of the UI to flicker after interacting with the Map and the Social menu.
[*] [b]Notifications[/b]: The notifications that appear after learning Plans for the Brahmin Grill, Milk Vending Machine, Grim Reaper Vault Boy Cutout, and Tinker’s Workbench now display the appropriate item names.
[*] [b]Pip-Boy[/b]: Opening the Keyring in the Pip-Boy’s Misc. inventory tab now correctly selects the first key in the list.
[*] [b]Pip-Boy[/b]: Exiting the Keyring to return to the Pip-Boy’s Misc. inventory tab now properly highlights the Keyring in the list.
[*] [b]Pip-Boy[/b]: Removed a non-functional “Drop” button that appeared when highlighting the Keyring in the Pip-Boy’s Misc. inventory tab.
[*] [b]Scoreboard[/b]: Fixed an issue that could cause the standard Rank 100 reward to appear incorrect for players who claimed the Fallout 1st Rank 100 reward first. [/list]
[h3]World[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Drop Site V9[/b]: Entering the pre-placed set of Power Armor at Drop Site V9 no longer causes a brief control lock.
[*] [b]Misc.[/b]: Corrected multiple locations throughout Appalachia where attempting to use pre-placed furniture could result in a brief control lock.
[*] [b]Pathing[/b]: Addressed several locations throughout Appalachia where the player could become stuck. [/list]

notes.title: FALLOUT 76 UPDATE NOTES – JULY 26, 2022
notes.content:
Our latest update for Fallout 76 brings a variety of new bug fixes and improvements to the game. Read on to catch all the details.
--- 
[h2]Update Version 1.6.4.78[/h2]

[b]PC (Steam): [/b]3.0 GB
--- 
[h2]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Art[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Apparel[/b]: The Black Jack-o’-Lantern Helmet now correctly emits smoke and flame visual effects.
[*] [b]Apparel[/b]: Underarmors no longer clip through the Vault Survivor Outfit.
[*] [b]Beds[/b]: Characters no longer clip into the Wavy Willard’s Waterbed when climbing into the top bunk.
[*] [b]Chairs[/b]: When seated in the Throne of Bone, the character’s hand now correctly rests on the skull.
[*] [b]Workbenches[/b]: Meat no longer appears to partially float during the cooking animation that plays while using the Chuckwagon Cooking Station. [/list]

[h3]C.A.M.P.s & Workshops[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Allies:[/b] The Settler Forager Ally can once again give Daily Quests to the player.
[*][b] Appliances[/b]: The Wavy Willards Bubble Blower is now located in the same row of items in the Build Menu as the Wavy Willards Bubble Machine, instead of appearing in a row by itself.
[*] [b]Collectron Stations[/b]: The F.E.T.C.H. Collectron is now correctly classified as a robot.
[*][b] Exploit[/b]: Addressed an item duplication exploit.
[*] [b]Exploit[/b]: Addressed an exploit that could enable a player to move items from a Public Workshop to their C.A.M.P.
[*] [b]Floors[/b]: The amount of C.A.M.P. budget consumed by Log Cabin Porches is now consistent with other Porch variants.
[*] [b]Floor Décor[/b]: Classical Columns can now be snapped on top of one another.
[*] [b]Mannequins[/b]: The build limit for the Dr. Bones Skeleton Mannequin is now consistent with other Mannequin variants.
[*] [b]Survival Tents[/b]: The Scrapbox no longer faces the wrong direction in the Rusted APC Survival Tent. [/list]

[h3]Challenges[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Combat[/b]: Killing robots with the Voice of Set now correctly progresses the “Kill Robots with a Revolver” Challenge.
[*] [b]Weekly[/b]: Fixed an issue that prevented the “Kill a Huge Creature” Weekly Challenge from progressing correctly. [/list]

[h3]Combat[/h3][list]
[*] [b]VATS[/b]: Explosive weapon attacks in VATS no longer increase the critical hit meter twice. [/list]

[h3]Events & Quests [/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Eviction Notice[/b]: Corrected a small area near the Rad Scrubber where players would take far less rad damage than intended while the Rad Scrubber was broken.
[*] [b]Eviction Notice[/b]: The Rad Scrubber’s windmill now correctly stops turning when the Rad Scrubber needs repairs, and when the event ends in failure.
[*] [b]Grahm’s Meat-Cook[/b]: Players now receive proper rewards based on the success of the Meat-Cook, rather than always receiving items from the event’s lowest reward tier.
[*] [b]Grahm’s Meat-Cook[/b]: Grahm will no longer wander away from the Meat-Cook to explore other areas in The Forest region.
[*] [b]Heart of the Swamp[/b]: The Strangler Heart no longer visually appears to regenerate health while taking damage from players.
[*] [b]Invaders from Beyond[/b]: When speaking with Homer at Black Mountain Ordnance Works, selecting the “That’s all for now” response option now correctly closes the dialogue menu.
[*] [b]Invaders from Beyond[/b]: Fixed an issue that could prevent dialogue from starting correctly when attempting to speak with Homer at Black Mountain Ordnance Works.
[*] [b]Moonshine Jamboree[/b]: Addressed an issue that could cause Moonshine Jamboree to end in failure even though players had deposited enough Acidic Gulper Venom to complete the objectives.
[*] [b]Moonshine Jamboree[/b]: A notification will now appear to inform the player that they lack the required materials if they attempt to deposit Acidic Gulper Venom into the bathtub when they don’t have any in their inventory.
[*] [b]Test Your Metal:[/b] Fixed an issue that could cause the Golden Eyebot to appear hostile toward players, and allow them to target it with VATS. [/list]

[h3]Items[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]ProSnap Deluxe Camera[/b]: Added a new option to the ProSnap Deluxe Camera that allows players to decide whether or not the pictures they take will be saved to the Photo Gallery.
[*] [i]While aiming through the Camera’s viewfinder, use the “Toggle Saving” button to choose whether your photos you take will be saved or discarded.[/i]
[*] [i]Photos taken while the Camera is set to “Not Saving” will still progress Quests and Challenges that require the player to take photos.[/i]
[*] [b]Armor[/b]: Applying a Deep Pocketed mod to a piece of limb armor now correctly updates the armor’s appearance.
[*] [b]Energy Weapons[/b]: The item condition for energy weapons now degrades at a more reasonable rate.
[*] [b]Energy Weapons[/b]: Made improvements to Automatic Barrel mods for the Ultracite Laser Gun so that they perform comparably with Automatic Barrel mods for the normal Laser Gun.
[*] [b]Exploit[/b]: Addressed an exploit that enabled players to trade items that are normally untradable.
[*] [b]Melee Weapons[/b]: The description of The Invader Skin now correctly states that it can be applied to Batons.
[*] [b]Power Armor[/b]: The “Skull Raider” name prefix now appears correctly after applying the Skull Raider Paint to pieces of Power Armor.
[*] [b]Quest Items[/b]: Fixed an issue that could prevent a character with a large stack of quest items in its inventory, like Government Supply Requisitions, from loading into a world.
[*] [b]Ranged Weapons[/b]: When firing an automatic weapon while affected by the frozen status, the weapon’s sound effects now more closely match its visual effects. [/list]

[h3]Localization[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Eviction Notice[/b]: The notification that appears when the Rad Scrubber has been repaired is now properly translated in non-English versions of the game.
[*] [b]Scorched Earth[/b]: Event objectives, notifications, the description, and all other text that appears during Scorched Earth are now properly translated in non-English versions of the game.
[*] [b]Scoreboard[/b]: The Secret Service Dog Statues reward is now properly translated on the Scoreboard in French, Italian, Japanese, Polish, and Russian versions of the game.
[*] [b]Settings[/b]: Increased the font size of Corpse Highlighting options in non-English versions of the game so that they are easier to read.
[*] [b]Test Your Metal:[/b] Added proper translations for several lines of dialogue from Initiate Pappas and Botsmith Amp in non-English versions of the game.
[*] [b]Weapons[/b]: Tone Death and Foundation’s Vengeance are now properly translated in non-English versions of the game. [/list]

[h3]Perk Cards[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Awareness[/b]: When the player has both the Awareness and Stabilized Perk Cards equipped, all types of damage reduction will now be correctly displayed.
[*] [b]E.M.T.[/b]: Revived players now receive Health Regeneration for the full duration stated on the E.M.T. Perk Card. [/list]

[h3]Stability[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Server Stability[/b]: Fixed an issue that could result in a server crash during normal gameplay. [/list]

[h3]User Interface[/h3][list]
[*] [b]Character Creation[/b]: Fixed an issue that could prevent players from creating a new character, even if they had fewer than 5 existing characters.
[*] [b]Controls[/b]: Attempting to open the Map while running a Holotape Game no longer causes the controls to become unresponsive.
[*] [b]Scoreboard[/b]: Players can no longer spam the confirmation button after using the “Rank Up to Here” button on the Scoreboard. [/list]

notes.title: Fallout 76 Test Your Metal Update Notes – June 14, 2022
notes.content:
Our latest update for Fallout 76 launches today, and it brings a triple-threat of new Public Events, Fallout 76 Season 9, Fallout 1st enhancements for the Scoreboard, Corpse Highlights, and much more to the game. Read on to catch all the details.
--- 
[h2]Update Highlights [/h2] [list]
[*] [b]Can You Compete?[/b] Join forces with the Gladiators of Steel and “Test Your Metal” against an army of Rust Eagle robots across three rounds of combat at the Metal Dome in the Savage Divide.
[*] [b]It’s Gulper Season![/b] You’re cordially invited to the Moonshine Jamboree at the Sunday Brothers Cabin. Fend off an onslaught of Gulpers, harvest their venom, and then raise a glass of Mire Magic Moonshine. 
[*] [b]Goodbye, Super Mutants[/b]: Gear up to hand-deliver an “Eviction Notice” to a horde of Super Mutants, who recently overtook a Settler outpost near Foundation. Prepare for a tough fight, and don’t forget to defend the Rad Scrubber.
[*] [b]Conquer Dread Island:[/b] Earn S.C.O.R.E. to rank-up and claim a host of rewards on the all-new Fallout 76 Season 9 Scoreboard, “Heart of Steel: A Dread Island Tale.”
[*] [b]Fallout 1st Enhancements[/b]: Members can claim S.C.O.R.E. Boosts and complete bonus Challenges to earn even more S.C.O.R.E. this Season, as well as unlock additional rank-up rewards from the Scoreboard.
[*] [b]Easily Spot Fallen Foes:[/b] The new “Corpse Highlights” setting makes it easier than ever to quickly find enemies you’ve taken down and claim your hard-earned loot. [/list]
--- 
[h2]Update Version 1.6.4.60[/h2]

Check the download sizes below for today’s patch on your platform of choice:
PC Steam: 18.6 GB
--- 
[h2]Dive Into Three New Public Events[/h2]
Today’s update introduces three new Public Events to Fallout 76: “Test Your Metal,” “Moonshine Jamboree,” and “Eviction Notice.” Catch a brief rundown on each event below, and then head in-game to check them out!

[b]Please Note[/b]: We’ve temporarily adjusted Public Event selection until June 28, so that you will have more opportunities to try out our three newest Public Events over the next two weeks. [list]
[*] Every hour, at the top of the hour, one of “Test Your Metal,” “Moonshine Jamboree,” or “Eviction Notice,” will be selected to begin. 
[*] At 20 and 40 minutes after the hour, one event will be selected at random from the full Public Event pool, which includes our newest three. 
[*] After June 28, Public Events will resume being selected completely at random every 20 minutes. [/list]

[b]“Test Your Metal” in the Arena[/b]
The Brotherhood of Steel have uncovered that a group of Blood Eagles, calling themselves the Rust Eagles, have been stockpiling spare robot parts to construct an army of combat bots. Concerned about the threat this may pose to Appalachia, Scribe Valdez recently sent a field team to investigate. Now, you can join forces with the “Gladiators of Steel” in a fierce contest to survive against the robots inside the Rust Eagle Arena. 

The “Test Your Metal” Public Event will appear on your map at the Metal Dome, north of Fort Atlas in the Savage Divide. Travel there and speak with Initiate Pappas to start the event. 
Once Test Your Metal begins, you will join three members of the Brotherhood field team to compete as gladiators against the Rust Eagles’ deadly machines. [list]
[*] You and the Gladiators of Steel will square off against the bots in three rounds of frenzied combat. [/list] 
Defeat the opposition in one round, and you’ll advance to the next. [list]
[*] Once you’ve conquered all three rounds, you will earn some loot, XP, and have a chance to pick up rare rewards, including plans to craft the new Botsmith Armor set.
[*] Keep a lookout for the Golden Eyebot to make an appearance! Do your best to take it down to claim an added bounty of Caps. [/list]
Make sure to defend your teammates, and have Stimpaks at the ready if they fall. The more Gladiators of Steel who survive their time in the ring, the higher your chances to earn rare rewards.

[b]Deliver an Eviction Notice[/b]
The Settlers at Foundation have been working to expand their territory by setting up a new encampment within a nearby blast crater. They even managed to engineer a solution to the crater’s immense radiation levels by inventing a machine known as a “Rad Scrubber.” However, a radio broadcast from one of the Settlers at the construction site indicated that they’ve been forced out by a band of Super Mutants. Visit the crater to assess the situation, and ensure the area is safe so that work can get back underway.

“Eviction Notice” is a challenging new Public Event tuned for higher-level characters. It will appear on your map in the Savage Divide at a crater that can be found east of Foundation, and south of Huntersville.
Find and activate the Rad Scrubber within the crater, and then prepare for a fight! [list]
[*] Defend the Settlers’ supply crates and the Rad Scrubber from an onslaught of Super Mutants.
[*] If the Rad Scrubber takes too much damage, it will deactivate. Repair it as quickly as possible, or else rad levels in the area will become much more hazardous. 
[*] [b]TIP[/b]: Destroy the Super Mutants’ meat bags to discourage them from sticking around. You and your event mates may want to try splitting up so that some players can venture out to attack the meat bags, while others focus on defense. [/list]
If you’re successful in driving the Super Mutants from the crater, you will earn Settler faction reputation, some loot, and a chance to receive one of six unique 3-star legendary weapons.

[b]Join the Moonshine Jamboree[/b]
You’re invited to join in the Moonshine Jamboree at the Sunday Brothers Cabin! It’s tragic what befell the Sunday boys, but their devotion to mixing up the finest moonshine in all of Appalachia lives on with Moonshiner Ned, their trusty Handy bot. There’s just one problem: Mire Magic Moonshine’s key ingredient is Gulper venom, which Ned can’t acquire alone. That’s where the Jamboree truly shines. Help Ned pick up where the Sunday Brothers left off, by hosting a party that will attract as many of the beasts as possible to the Cabin.  

Meet up with Moonshiner Ned behind the bar inside Sunday Brothers Cabin in The Mire to kick off the festivities.
Light the Jamboree Bonfire, and then keep your guard up. Vicious Gulpers and other curious creatures 
 list]
[*] will soon flood the area to investigate the raucous Jamboree.
[*] Take down Gulpers and collect as much Acidic Gulper Venom as you can. Pour it, as directed by Moonshiner Ned, into a nearby bathtub so that it can be used to serve up a fresh batch of moonshine.
[*] Make sure to defend the three Stills located around the Cabin grounds. If they get destroyed the party will be ruined!
[/list]
If you manage to deposit 30 Acidic Gulper Venom in time, and the Stills remain intact, then the Jamboree will be a roaring success. [list]
[*] The most masterful moonshiners among you can optionally collect up to 60 Acidic Gulper Venom before the event concludes for increased rewards. [/list]
Speaking of rewards, by completing Moonshine Jamboree, you will earn Raider faction reputation, some loot, the all-new “Gulper Smacker” melee weapon, and a few bottles of Gulpershine, which you can drink to increase the Gulper Smacker’s damage vs. Gulpers.
--- 
[h2]Fallout 76 Season 9: New Scoreboard, Rewards & More![/h2]
Here’s what’s headed your way during Fallout 76 Season 9, which begins today:

[h3]New Scoreboard[/h3]
Following a turbulent storm and an ill-fated flight around the world, Anna and Emilio Franklin now find themselves stranded on the wonderous and deadly Dread Island, with only their assaultron bodyguard, H-4RT, to help them survive. Keep up with their adventures by earning S.C.O.R.E. to rank up and claim a new suite of rewards on the all-new Season 9 Scoreboard. [list]
[*] As you progress during your Season journey, you will unlock new paints for your weapons, armor, and Power Armor, amenities for your C.A.M.P., outfits, cosmetics, consumables, and more! [/list]

[h3]Fallout 1st Enhancements[/h3]
With Season 9, we’re introducing enhancements to the Scoreboard that will help Fallout 1st Members rank-up more quickly and claim even more rank-up rewards along the way.

[b]Unlock S.C.O.R.E. Boosts[/b]: Fallout 1st Members can claim three new S.C.O.R.E. Boost rewards at ranks 15, 50, and 75, which increase the S.C.O.R.E. they earn from Challenges for the rest of Season 9 by +5%, +10%, and +10%, respectively. [list]
[*] [b]Please note[/b]: Boosts count toward a Challenge’s base S.C.O.R.E. reward. They do not multiply with other bonus effects, such as Double S.C.O.R.E. Weekends.
[*] For example, if you’ve unlocked all three S.C.O.R.E. Boosts, and you then complete a Challenge for 100 S.C.O.R.E., you will earn a total of 125. If you complete that same Challenge during a Double S.C.O.R.E. Weekend, you will earn its base value of 100 S.C.O.R.E., plus 100 more due to the event, and 25 from your boosts, for a total of 225 S.C.O.R.E. [/list]
[b]Complete Bonus Challenges[/b]: Members can also earn even more S.C.O.R.E. by completing Fallout 1st Bonus Challenges, which will appear as Daily or Weekly Challenges alongside the existing lineup in the Challenges menu.
[b]Claim Even More Rewards[/b]: This Season’s Scoreboard features many additional rank-up rewards for Fallout 1st Members. Hover over rank-up icons that have a gold ring on the Scoreboard to display both the standard and Fallout 1st rewards for that rank, side-by-side.

[h3]Fresh Radio Plays [/h3]
Tune your Pip-Boy’s radio dial to the Pirate Radio Station to catch six new Radio Plays that follow along with Anna, Emilio, and H-4RT as they explore Dread Island and try to survive its many perils.

You can also catch additional details about Fallout 76 Season 9 by heading to the [url=https://fallout.bethesda.net/en/seasons]Seasons page on Fallout.com[/url], or by [url=https://fallout.bethesda.net/en/article/6oPmdlAl7U16yCnnHGOfcS/fallout-76-inside-the-vault-conquer-dread-island-during-fallout-76-season-9]reading our recent article[/url].

--- 

[h2]Spot Fallen Foes More Easily with Corpse Highlighting[/h2]
You’ve just dropped a Legendary Feral Ghoul—but wait, where is its body? Was it over there? No, perhaps it’s over here… 

We’ve all been there before, hunting through tall grass trying to find an enemy’s final resting place, so that we can grab our loot and head back to C.A.M.P. This update introduces Corpse Highlighting, which will help you more easily spot nearby creature corpses and claim your hard-earned loot.

Corpse Highlights will be enabled by default on the Display tab in the game’s Settings menu. [list]
[*] You can also toggle the setting to decide when you’d like Corpse Highlights to disappear from a fallen enemy: After hovering your crosshairs over the corpse to view their quick inventory, or after inspecting the corpse by viewing their full inventory menu. [/list]
--- 
[h2]Additional Changes & Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Critical Hit Bonus Adjustments[/h3] [list]
[*] Critical Hit damage bonuses are now all additive, and we've increased the bonuses from a wide variety of sources to help compensate for this change:
[*] Better Criticals Perk Card: Bonuses per Perk Card rank increased from +20/30/40% to +50/75/100%, respectively.
[*] Standard Receiver Mods: Bonus increased from +68% to +100%
[*] Auto Receiver Mods: Bonus increased from +36% to +50%
[*] Overdrive: Bonus increased from +15% to +30%
[*] Eagle Eyes Mutation: Bonus increased from +25% to +60%
[*] Eagle Eyes (when buffed by the "Stranger In Numbers" Perk Card): Bonus increased from +32% to +75%
[*] Tesla Science Magazine #8: Bonus increased from +15% to +50%
[*] Firecracker Berry Juice: Bonus increased from +10% to +25%
[*] Sweet Mutfruit Tea, Megasloth Mushroom Soup, Blight Soup, Steeped Thistle Tea: Bonus increased from +20% to +50%
[*] All Magazines affecting per weapon type critical: Bonuses increased from +30% to +100% [/list]
--- 
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]Art[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Armor[/b]: Leather Left Arms with an equipped Brawling mod no longer appear to clip through the left shoulder of male characters.
[*] [b]Emotes[/b]: The “Halt!” Emote now plays animations correctly while wearing Power Armor.
[*] [b]Emotes[/b]: Using an Emote while standing in a fire or similar hazard no longer causes the player to become stuck in an Emote animation.
[*] [b]Enemies[/b]: Crippled Super Mutants no longer launch into the air on death.
[*] [b]Outfits[/b]: The Firewall Outfit’s Helmet now correctly displays a glass face shield while equipped.
[*] [b]Power Armor[/b]: The headlamp for Equalizer and Matte Black Equalizer Power Armor Paint now shines in the correct direction when applied to Hellcat Power Armor.
[*] [b]Power Armor[/b]: Applying the Yellow Power Armor Paint to a set of Power Armor now applies proper interior textures, as well.
[*] [b]Terminals[/b]: Corrected an animation issue when entering a Terminal that could cause the player’s view to become misaligned from the Terminal screen.
[*] [b]Weapons[/b]: Fixed an issue that could cause NPCs to hold Pipe Pistols at odd angles.
[*] [b]Weapons[/b]: Characters’ hands no longer clip into the Alien Disintegrator.
[*] [b]Weapons[/b]: The Alien Disintegrator’s impact visual effects now correctly change color based on which Receiver mod the player is using. [/list]

[h3]C.A.M.P.s & Workshops[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Ally Furniture[/b]: Sam Nguyen's Workbench can now be moved after being built.
[*] [b]Beds[/b]: Players can now correctly interact with the Alien Stasis Chamber Bed.
[*] [b]C.A.M.P. Deployable[/b]: Allies can now move toward a C.A.M.P. that has the Future Tec Skin applied to the C.A.M.P. Deployable.
[*] [b]Misc. Structures[/b]: The notification that appears after learning a West Virginia Slot Machine Plan that was purchased from a Gold Bullion Vendor now displays the correct item name.
[*] [b]Resources[/b]: Mineral Extractors now correctly appear in the C.A.M.P. Build Menu only when the player’s C.A.M.P. is near an appropriate Mineral Deposit.
[*] [b]Signs[/b]: Characters can no longer clip into the Water Park Sign.
[*] [b]Survival Tent[/b]: The Scrapbox in the APC Survival Tent is now facing the correct direction.
[/list]

[h3]Combat[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Stealth[/b]: Firing a silenced weapon while in Stealth no longer causes nearby enemies to instantly detect the player.
[*] [b]VATS[/b]: Fixed an issue in which VATS critical hits were not guaranteed to strike the target.
[*] [b]VATS[/b]: Fixed an issue that could cause VATS to randomly close while firing at an enemy with clear line of sight.
[*] [b]VATS[/b]: VATS no longer randomly closes while targeting certain robotic enemies.
[*] [b]VATS[/b]: VATS critical hit effect descriptions in the Pip-Boy now display damage numbers that match the actual damage dealt.
[*] [b]VATS[/b]: Firing explosive weapons in VATS no longer causes duplicate damage numbers to appear.
[*] [b]VATS[/b]: Firing a Missile Launcher in VATS now correctly progresses the critical hit meter.
[*] [b]VATS[/b]: Exiting a World with the ProSnap Deluxe Camera equipped no longer prevents the player from opening VATS after joining a new World.
[*] [b]VATS[/b]: Players can no longer target disarmed mines using VATS. [/list]

[h3]Enemies[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Handy Bots[/b]: Mr. Handy/Gutsy type robots can now correctly cycle their weapons.
[*] [b]Blood Eagles[/b]: Fixed an issue that prevented a Blood Eagle Cutthroat near Prickett’s Fort from reacting to the player’s presence. [/list]

[h3]Events & Quests [/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Ally[/b]: Crash Landing: Super Mutants now correctly approach the Crash Site when the player is retrieving the Flight Recorder.
[*] [b]Lode Baring[/b]: Fixed an issue in which players could not mine some mineral deposits during the Lode Baring Public Event.
[*] [b]Lode Baring[/b]: The miscellaneous objective to “Exchange tokens at Terminal” that displays after completing this Public Event no longer always reappears after logging out and back in.
[*] [b]Monster Mash[/b]: Removed a non-functioning reward option from the S.M.A.R.T. Choice Machine.
[*] [b]Overseer’s Mission[/b]: The Small Backpack Plan no longer spawns in the Overseer’s Cache inside the Morgantown Airport for players who have already learned it.
[*] [b]Overseer’s Mission[/b]: The Overseer's Cache at Site Bravo now correctly spawns Vault Boy and Vault Girl Statue plans instead of two Vault Girl Statue plans. These plans no longer spawn in the Overseer’s Cache if the player has already learned them.
[*] [b]Path to Enlightenment[/b]: The Lighthouse Lamp no longer continues to prompt the player to “Deposit Bioluminescent Fluid” after completing this Public Event.
[*] [b]Trade Secrets[/b]: Players can now correctly pass through the laser grid to access the Hornwright Estate Safe Room, as long as they’ve collected the required keycard. [/list]

[h3]Fallout Worlds[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Custom Worlds[/b]: Fixed an issue in which characters that were linked to a shared Custom World could still join that World after the owner had deleted it. [/list]

[h3]Items[/h3][list] 
[*] [b]Armor[/b]: Thorn Armor’s description now correctly indicates that it deals 250 damage.
[*] [b]Armor[/b]: The Shrouded mod for Wood Armor now correctly provides improved Stealth in dark areas.
[*] [b]Armor[/b]: Fixed an issue causing Hardened mods for Brotherhood Recon and Secret Service Armors to provide less Damage Resistance than intended.
[*] [b]Armor[/b]: Fixed an issue causing the Fiberglass mod for Combat Armor to provide less Damage Resistance than intended.
[*] [b]Armor[/b]: Crafting Sturdy Robot Torso Armor no longer costs fewer materials than intended.
[*] [b]Armor[/b]: Arctic Marine Armor can now receive the same armor paints that Marine Armor can.
[*] [b]Backpacks[/b]: Fixed a visual issue causing the High-Capacity Backpack mod to display astronomically huge Damage Resistance stats.
[*] [b]Exploit[/b]: Addressed an exploit through which players could significantly increase the size of a weapon’s magazine.
[*] [b]Exploit[/b]: Addressed an exploit through which it was possible to duplicate a set of Power Armor.
[*] [b]Food and Drinks[/b]: Pip-Boy item previews for alcoholic beverages now correctly display any S.P.E.C.I.A.L. bonuses and penalties the player will receive after consuming them.
[*] [b]Item Names[/b]: Corrected several typos and naming inconsistencies across a variety of different item plans and mods.
[*] [b]Power Armor[/b]: The Father Winter Power Armor Helmet can now be restored to its standard appearance.
[*] [b]Power Armor[/b]: Excavator Power Armor Arms now correctly provide extra ore from mining when both left and right arms are equipped.
[*] [b]Power Armor[/b]: Equipping a Power Armor Torso with the Kinetic Dynamo mod no longer interferes with the effects of the Kinetic Servos mod on Power Armor Legs.
[*] [b]Legendary Weapons[/b]: The Lucky Legendary weapon effect now correctly provides its 15% bonus to the critical hit meter’s fill rate.
[*] [b]Legendary Weapons[/b]: The “Cursed” prefix now properly appears in the names of Cursed Legendary Weapons.
[*] [b]Melee Weapons:[/b] The Switchblade can now be restored to its standard appearance.
[*] [b]Melee Weapons[/b]: The Revolutionary Sword no longer has an extra “no upgrade” mod that visually removes its blade.
[*] [b]Ranged Weapons[/b]: The Handmade Rifle’s Tweaked Receiver mod now correctly increases critical hit damage.
[*] [b]Ranged Weapons[/b]: The Flamer now takes condition damage at a lower rate.
[*] [b]Ranged Weapons[/b]: Fixed an issue that prevented the Cryolator from taking condition damage.
[*] [b]Rewards[/b]: Corrected an issue in which a number of former Nuclear Winter mode rewards could be traded or built in the C.A.M.P.s of players who did not own them. [/list]

[h3]Perk Cards[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Mr. Sandman[/b]: The Mr. Sandman Perk Card no longer provides a different sneak attack bonus when equipped before or after the Covert Ops Perk Card. Additionally, the sneak attack bonus from Mr. Sandman has been doubled at all ranks.
[*] [b]Quick Hands[/b]: Fixed an issue that could cause the Quick Hands Perk Card to trigger more often than intended.
[*] [b]Super Duper:[/b] Fixed an issue that could cause the Super Duper Perk Card’s fanfare to play even though the Perk hadn’t triggered. [/list]

[h3]Sound[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Music[/b]: Daily Ops music no longer plays in interior cells when the player isn’t participating in a Daily Op. [/list]

[h3]User Interface[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Challenge Tracker[/b]: Attempting to track multiple Challenges in quick succession no longer causes Challenges to visually duplicate in the Challenge Tracker.
[*] [b]Notifications[/b]: Following a successful sneak attack with a melee weapon, a notification now correctly appears to inform the player that the attack dealt bonus damage.
[*] [b]Player Vending Machines[/b]: Players can now inspect items listed for sale in other players’ Vending Machines, and the preview images for items now correctly appear in the Vending Machine menu.
[*] [b]Quest Tracker[/b]: Addressed an issue in which a Public Event would sometimes not appear in the quest tracker after Fast Traveling to that Public Event via the Map or World Activity menu.
[*] [b]Scoreboard[/b]: Fallout 1st rewards for previously achieved rank-ups now correctly appear claimable if the player joins Fallout 1st partway through a Season.
[*] [b]Trade[/b]: Legendary item previews in player trade menus now correctly display all of an item’s legendary attributes. [/list]

[h3]World[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Pathing[/b]: Addressed a number of locations where the player could become stuck. [/list]

notes.title: Fallout 76 Update Notes – April 12, 2022
notes.content:
Our latest update for Fallout 76 brings a variety of new bug fixes to the game. Read on to catch all the details.
--- 
[h2]Update Version 1.6.4.31[/h2]
[b]PC (Steam)[/b]: 2.2 GB
--- 
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]Art[/h3] [list]
[*] [b][b]Weapons[/b]:[/b] The Silver Shroud Tesla Rifle paint now correctly applies to the Charging Shotgun Barrel mod. [/list]
[h3]C.A.M.P.s & Workshops[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Exploit[/b]: Fixed an issue in which cheaters could place NPCs in the game world.
[*] [b]Lights[/b]: The Diner Wall Light now correctly plays a sound effect when toggling it on and off.
[*] [b]Structures[/b]: Wires can now be attached to the power connector on the Firewatch Tower.
[*] [b]Structures[/b]: The Red Backwoods Bungalow now has an accompanying door, which can be found in the Doors tab in the build menu.
[*] [b]Structures[/b]: Players can now correctly place Blueprints that contain the Charleston Fire Station.
[*] [b]Walls[/b]: Wall Décor items, like Pennants, Frames, Posters, Signs, and etc., no longer clip into Enclave C.A.M.P. Walls. [/list]
[h3]Challenges[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]World[/b]: The requirements for the “Complete Different Daily Quests” World Challenge have been reduced from 23 to 22, and it can now be correctly completed. [/list]
[h3]Combat[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]VATS[/b]: Melee VATS attacks while in third-person view no longer cause the player to encounter a black screen. [/list]
[h3]Enemies[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]General[/b]: Addressed instances where enemies could sometimes become frozen and unresponsive.
[*] [b]Wolves[/b]: Fixed an issue that could prevent Wolves and other dog-type enemies from attacking the player. [/list]
[h3]Events & Quests [/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Public Events:[/b] Using the World Activity Tracker to Fast Travel to a Public Event that the player is already participating in no longer causes them to be removed from that event.
[*] [b]Public Events[/b]: Players now correctly join an active Public Event when walking into the event location.
[*] [b]Lode Baring[/b]: The quest tracker no longer persists on-screen after completing Lode Baring. [/list]
[h3]Fallout Worlds[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Relaxed Building Restrictions[/b]: Setting the snapping toggle to “Collide” now correctly allows placement of C.A.M.P. objects without encountering “intersecting object” errors. [/list]
[h3]Items[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Armor[/b]: Fixed an issue that caused Thorn Armor’s bleed effect to stack unintentionally. To help account for this change, the bleed effect now deals five times its previous damage.
[*] [b]Exploit[/b]: Addressed an exploit that could cause a weapon to deal more damage than intended under certain circumstances.
[*] [b]Exploit:[/b] Addressed an exploit in which players could obtain certain magazines repeatedly from the same location.
[*] [b]Headwear:[/b] The Captain Cosmos Helmet now correctly prevents damage and disease from airborne hazards.
[*] [b]Melee Weapons:[/b] VATS attacks using automatic melee weapons, like the Ripper, now correctly progress the critical hit meter.
[*] [b]Ranged Weapons[/b]: Missile Launchers now correctly take condition damage from use, and they are no longer unbreakable.
[*] [b]Ranged Weapons[/b]: Alien Blaster and Alien Disintegrator projectiles now correctly impact objects and terrain. [/list]
[h3]Localization [/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Animation[/b]: Addressed an issue that could cause water sources to appear to stop flowing when playing Fallout 76 in a language other than English. [/list]
[h3]NPCs[/h3] [list]
