[*] [b]Allies[/b]: Allies no longer continue to appear as though they have a weapon drawn after leaving combat. [/list]
[h3]Performance & Stability [/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Client Stability[/b]: Fixed a client crash that could occur when using VATS melee attacks in third-person view.
[*] [b]Client Stability[/b]: Fixed a client crash that could occur when rapidly scrapping and storing objects in a C.A.M.P. that had reached the maximum build budget. [/list]
[h3]Sound[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Keyring[/b]: Added sound effects that play when opening and closing the Keyring in the Pip-Boy.
[*] [b]Grenades[/b]: Excess sound effects no longer play when drawing a weapon with certain types of grenades equipped.
[*] [b]Sirens[/b]: Toggling a Siren on and off repeatedly no longer causes its sound effects to stack. [/list]
[h3]User Interface[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Nearby Corpses[/b]: Lengthy enemy names are now spaced and sized more appropriately in the Nearby Corpses menu.
[*] [b]Photomode[/b]: Dr. Zorbo themed poses are once again available for use in Photomode for players who earned them during Season 7.
[*] [b]Photomode[/b]: Adjusted the Photomode pose list so that pose titles and animations are back in sync.
[*][b] Scoreboard[/b]: On consoles, the player’s current Atom balance now updates immediately after purchasing Ranks via the “Rank Up to Here” button on the Scoreboard.
[*] [b]Scoreboard[/b]: Fixed an issue that caused the “Rank Up to Here” button to remain greyed out after purchasing Atoms.
[*] [b]Settings[/b]: Using the “Defaults” button in the Display options menu now correctly reverts Display settings to their default values. [/list]

notes.title: Fallout 76 Update Notes – March 1, 2022
notes.content:
Our latest update for Fallout 76 launches today, and it brings a new Seasonal Event, Fallout 76 Season 8, Fallout Worlds improvements, and much more to the game. Read on to catch all the details.
--- 
[h2]Update Highlights[/h2] [list]
[*] [b]Aliens Have Landed:[/b] Extraterrestrials are here, and they want siphon our brainwaves! Until March 15, band together with other Dwellers every hour on the hour to take on an out-of-this-world new Seasonal Event.
[*] [b]Season 8 Begins[/b]: Relive your glory days inside the comfy confines of the Vault as you rank-up and claim new weapon and armor paints, C.A.M.P. objects, a new Ally, and many more rewards on the Season 8 Scoreboard.
[*] [b]Earn S.C.O.R.E. in Fallout Worlds:[/b] Continue your Season journey in Public and Custom Worlds by completing Challenges to earn S.C.O.R.E., rank up, and claim Scoreboard rewards.
[*] [b]New Custom Worlds Settings[/b]: Experiment in your Custom Worlds with more freedom to place intersecting C.A.M.P. objects, the ability to toggle VATS and Perk Card effects, and more! [/list]
--- 
[h2]Update Version 1.6.2.15[/h2]
[b]PC (Steam):[/b] 11.6 GB GB
--- 
[h2]New Seasonal Event[/h2]
Mysterious beings from the outer reaches of space have arrived in our skies, and they’re planning to steal the brainwaves from lifeforms throughout Appalachia! Band together with your fellow humans to take on the alien scum and send them fleeing back into their ships before they can complete their “research.” 
[b]Every hour on the hour until March 15[/b], an Alien Mothership will materialize above one of six Appalachian landmarks to deploy three Brainwave Siphons in the area.[list]
[*] Travel to the Mothership’s location and examine Siphon Kappa to start the event. [/list]
When the event begins, work to destroy all three Brainwave Siphons, one after the other, before the aliens can complete their Brainwave Extraction process. [list]
[*] There’s just one problem: Each Siphon is protected by a force field, which is controlled by a different Alien Commander.
[*] Defeat alien forces to draw out the Commander for each Siphon. Take out the Commander and the force field will drop, allowing you and your event mates to destroy the Siphon. [/list]
If you manage to demolish all three Brainwave Siphons in time, you will receive some loot, XP, and have a chance to earn plans to craft new alien weaponry, like the Alien Disintegrator and Electro Enforcer, as well as high-tech new C.A.M.P. objects. 
Keep your guard up, because as long as the Seasonal Event is live, you may encounter extraterrestrial interlopers at select Public Events, including Campfire Tales, Free Range, and Line in the Sand. You may also spot our curious visitors in new Random Encounters that we’re adding with this update. 
--- 
[h2]Fallout 76 Season 8: New Scoreboard, Rewards & More![/h2]
Here’s what’s headed your way during Fallout 76 Season 8, which begins today:
[b]New Scoreboard[/b]: Relive the glory days of your past life inside the cozy confines of the Vault on an all-new Scoreboard for Season 8. Achieve Rank 100 (and beyond!) once again this Season to earn a suite of new rewards that would even make an Overseer jealous. [list] 
[*] As you progress during your Season journey, you will unlock new paints for your weapons, armor, and Power Armor, stylish amenities for your C.A.M.P., a new Ally, outfits, cosmetics, consumables, and more![/list]
[b]Rank Purchasing Improvements[/b]: Clicking over and over to purchase rank-ups with Atoms one at a time can be a drag! We’ve added a new option to the Season Scoreboard, which you can use to purchase as many rank-ups as you’d like, all in one go. [list]
[*] Select the rank you’d like to reach and then press the “Rank Up to Here” button at the bottom of the Scoreboard screen. 
[*] After confirming your purchase, you will immediately rank up to that position on the Scoreboard. You will also unlock all of the rewards between your chosen rank and where you began. [/list]
[b]Fresh Radio Plays[/b]: Tune in to Pirate Radio to experience all the drama, intrigue, and suspense that come with living in close quarters alongside other Dwellers. Sponsored by Abraxo Chemical, our latest round of Radio Plays for Season 8 follows the lives and times of Vault Dwellers as they struggle to get along.
Catch additional details about Fallout 76 Season 8 by heading to the [url=https://fallout.bethesda.net/en/seasons]Seasons page on Fallout.com[/url], or by [url=https://fallout.bethesda.net/en/article/750NjQsVcscC1G5mSxn4DT/fallout-76-inside-the-vault-welcome-to-season-8]heading here to read our recent article[/url].
--- 
[h2]Fallout Worlds Improvements[/h2]
[h3]Earn S.C.O.R.E. in Fallout Worlds![/h3]
In response to community feedback, we’ve implemented the ability for you to continue your Season journey in Fallout Worlds. Going forward, you will now be able to earn S.C.O.R.E. from non-repeatable Daily and Weekly Challenges you complete while playing in Public and Custom Worlds. 
[h3]New Custom World Settings to Explore[/h3]
We’re introducing a variety of new settings for Custom Worlds that Fallout 1st members can tinker with in their Custom Worlds. Catch a brief description of each below, and then head in-game to adjust your Custom Worlds and make these settings your own. [list]
[*] [b]Carry Weight[/b]: Set how much weight a player can carry to a specific number, reduce it to zero, or multiply it up to eleven times the default amount. 
[*] [b]Frequent Confetti:[/b] New Dismemberment setting that will cause enemies you take down to explode into a cloud of confetti.
[*] [b]Perk Effects[/b]: Choose whether players can benefit from Normal Perk effects, Legendary Perk effects, both, or neither with this setting. 
[*] [b]VATS[/b]: We’ve added the ability to turn off VATS targeting versus other players, or even disable VATS entirely.
[*] [b]Relaxed Building Restrictions[/b]: When using "Relaxed Building Restrictions" in a Fallout World, you will now see a new "Placement Mode" option that can be toggled while building in a Workshop or C.A.M.P. Adjusting it will allow you to place C.A.M.P. objects even if they intersect.
[*] [b]Weather:[/b] If you enjoyed the darkened skies above the Mothman Equinox Seasonal Event, you can now bring it to your Custom Worlds using the Weather Setting. [/list]
Additionally, we’ve brought some of the new settings to certain Public Worlds so that everyone can try them out: [list]
[*] Happy Builder: Players can now adjust the Snapping Toggle to place intersecting objects in their C.A.M.P.s. 
[*] High Risk: Perk Card effects, Legendary Perk Card effects, and VATS have been disabled to provide an even riskier experience to thrill seekers. [/list]
--- 
[h2]Additional Changes & Improvements[/h2]
[b]Buildable Pirate Radio:[/b] Tap your toes to Appalachia’s newest radio station when you’re relaxing at home with a buildable Pirate Radio that you can place in your C.A.M.P. Open the build menu and navigate to the Appliances section to find it.
[b]Invisible Backpacks:[/b] The community has long requested the ability to hide their currently equipped backpacks from view. Now, you can do just that with the new “Show Backpack” toggle in the game’s settings menu. Don’t worry, you’ll still receive all the benefits of your pack while it’s hidden.
[b]Invulnerable Enemies[/b]: To help you more easily identify when creatures are invulnerable, we've added in a new shield icon to better indicate that they won’t take damage.
[b]Minerva[/b]: We’ve added several holiday-themed item plans to Minerva’s inventory that were previously only available in Nuclear Winter, so that you can purchase them with Gold Bullion.
[b]Overbudget C.A.M.P. Limits[/b]: Much like the absolute carry weight maximums we’ve introduced previously, in today’s update we’re implementing limits for C.A.M.P.s that are excessively overbudget. Upon login, the owners of C.A.M.P.s that have greatly surpassed the build budget will be notified that they are unable to perform certain actions while overbudget. The following actions will be disabled until the player scraps or destroys enough items to drop back under the budget limit:
[b]Fast Travel[/b]: On login, the owner will have one opportunity to travel to their overbudget C.A.M.P. to reduce its budget. If they don’t, Fast Travel will behave as if the player is overencumbered. [list]
[*] C.A.M.P. object placement, rearranging, and storing.
[*] C.A.M.P. Slot swapping
[*] C.A.M.P. broadcasting on the Map
[*] Furniture and activator interactions, including Shelter Entrances. [/list]
[b]Stimpak Adjustments[/b]: We’ve reduced the weight of Stimpaks and Diluted Stimpaks by 25%, and reduced their prices by 25% as well. Additionally, we’ve increased the number of Stimpaks and Diluted Stimpaks that will appear in Medical Vending Machines.
--- 
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]Art[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Outfits[/b]: Players’ ankles no longer stretch in odd ways while wearing the Hellcat Field Gear Outfit.
[*] [b]Weapons[/b]: Firing a Railway Rifle now correctly causes it to emit steam visual effects from the barrel. [/list]
[h3]C.A.M.P.s & Workshops[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Appliances:[/b] Popcorn from the Popcorn Machine now correctly reduces Hunger and Thirst gains by 25%.
[*] [b]Build[/b]: Items in the Build Menu’s “New” tab now remain visible after logging out and back in, and after relaunching the game client.
[*] [b]Build[/b]: Fixed an issue that could prevent certain C.A.M.P. objects from appearing in the Build Menu’s “New” tab.
[*] [b]Build[/b]: Scrapping or storing a C.A.M.P. object now correctly removes the grey highlight around that object.
[*] [b]Build[/b]: Selecting an object for placement and then switching to an empty tab in Build Mode now correctly removes the placement preview for that object.
[*] [b]Build[/b]: Slightly increased the crafting requirements for several C.A.M.P. items, such as Crops, which previously returned the same amount of crafting materials when scrapped as they cost to build.
[*] [b]Collectron Stations[/b]: Collectron Plans purchased using Gold Bullion, like the Nuka-Cola and Red Rocket Collectrons, now correctly grant access to their unique “Collect” options in the Collectron Station terminal.
[*] [b]Defenses[/b]: Adjusted the Wire attach point for Enclave Turrets so that players can now correctly connect Wires from one Enclave Turret to another.
[*] [b]Defenses[/b]: Enclave Turrets now correctly play sound effects while powered.
[*] [b]Displays[/b]: When scrapping or storing Display Cases and Mannequins, a warning now appears stating that any items assigned to that Display or Mannequin will be unassigned.
[*] [b]Displays[/b]: The Pepper Shaker is now properly aligned when assigned to wall-mounted weapon Displays.
[*] [b]Displays[/b]: Souvenir Teddy Bear variants now face the correct direction when assigned to a Display.
[*] [b]Displays[/b]: The Fasnacht Mask Display now has a build limit of 30.
[*] [b]Exploit[/b]: Addressed an exploit that allowed players to duplicate certain Crops.
[*] [b]Flags[/b]: Flag objects now have a build limit of 10.
[*] [b]Misc.[/b]: The West Virginia Slot Machine now has a build limit of 5.
[*] [b]Modify[/b]: Fixed a visual issue that could cause incorrect error messages to appear when attempting to replace a C.A.M.P. object using the Modify Menu.
[*] [b]Power[/b]: Ceiling Conduit Junctions can now correctly connect through Enclave Flat Roof pieces to electrical objects placed beneath.
[*] [b]Stairs[/b]: Removed the railing at the top of the Guild of Antiquities Stairs with Posts, which could clip with other objects when built indoors.
[*] [b]Structures[/b]: The Wildwood Den can now be sunk into the terrain more easily, and in cases where the terrain isn’t perfectly flat, it will appear closer to the ground and more natural than before.
[*] [b]Walls[/b]: Upper-level flooring pieces no longer clip into Enclave C.A.M.P. Walls. [/list]
[h3]Challenges[/h3] [list]
[*] Combat: Brotherhood Recon Armor Plans now correctly progress lifetime Challenges that require the player to learn Armor Plans.
[*] Weekly: The “Repeatable Under Rank 100: Gain XP” Weekly Challenge is now correctly available at Rank 99.
[*] World: “Pass the Buck” has been removed from the list of subchallenges for the “Complete Different Daily Quests” World Challenge.
[*] World: The Dirty Fedora and Crumpled Fedora now count toward progress for the Possum: Archaeologist World Challenge to “Collect bones while wearing a Fedora.”
[/list]
[h3]Combat[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Elemental Resistances[/b]: Adjusted the calculation for energy and elemental damage to be in line with physical damage calculation. As a result, energy and elemental damage have been increased overall.
[*] [b]Enemy Health[/b]: Addressed an instance of enemy health “rubber banding” that could occur when using a high rate of fire weapon under poor network conditions.
[*] [b]Floating Damage Numbers[/b]: Armor penetration is now correctly factored into floating damage numbers that appear when attacking enemies.
[*] [b]VATS[/b]: Players can now use VATS to target and hit airborne grenades. [/list]
[h3]Daily Ops[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Bosses[/b]: Addressed an issue that could cause Daily Ops Bosses to flee from the player.
[*] [b]Rewards[/b]: Fusion Cores for the Ultracite Gatling Laser now appear in the contextual ammo rewards granted after completing a Daily Op. [/list]
[h3]Enemies[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Corpses[/b]: Opening the quick loot menu by hovering the crosshairs over a dismembered enemy corpse no longer causes that enemy’s limbs or clothing to reappear.
[*] [b]Humans[/b]: Corrected an issue that allowed human enemies to attempt to enter sets of pre-placed Power Armor.
[*] [b]Mothmen[/b]: Scorched Mothmen now correctly take bonus damage from weapons with the Zealot’s legendary attribute.
[*] [b]Wild Mongrels[/b]: After being crippled, Wild Mongrels now continue their attempts to attack the player instead of preferring to stare at them ominously. [/list]
[h3]Events & Quests [/h3] [list]
[*] [b]A Colossal Problem[/b]: Fixed an issue that could cause the Public Event, "A Colossal Problem", to begin after nuking Cranberry Bog to start Scorched Earth.
[*] [b]A Satisfied Conscience[/b]: Valdez and other NPCs no longer become stuck after taking cover at the end of the battle during this quest.
[*] [b]Campfire Tales[/b]: Fixed an issue that prevented players from remaining hidden from enemies while sneaking during the event.
[*] [b]Campfire Tales[/b]: Scout Leader Penny no longer plays placeholder voiceover for one of her lines during the boss fight.
[*] [b]Free Range[/b]: Players now earn the correct rewards after completing Free Range.
[*] [b]Lode Bearing[/b]: Ultracite Ore that spawns during this event is now correctly minable.
[*] [b]One Violent Night[/b]: Updated the text for the optional objective “Kill the Nightstalker bare-handed” to reflect that players can use explosives and thrown weapons.
[*] [b]Tea Time[/b]: Fixed an issue that could cause Tea Time to continue running in the background, which prevented the next Public Event from starting. [/list]
[h3]Fallout Worlds[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Legendary Perk Cards[/b]: Fixed an issue that could cause the Master Infiltrator Legendary Perk Card to unequip itself after joining a Custom World.
[*] [b]Menus[/b]: The ordering of Custom World settings categories is now uniform across different platforms.
[*] [b]Settings[/b]: Players can no longer earn Wanted status when PVP rules in a Custom World are set to “Never.”
[*] [b]Settings[/b]: When Fast Travel is disabled in a Custom World, players now correctly receive a message that they are unable to Fast Travel.
[*] [b]Settings[/b]: Jump animations are now smoother in Custom Worlds where Jump Height has been increased.
[*] [b]Settings[/b]: Jumping while overencumbered no longer consumes Action Points when Jump AP Cost is set to “Zero” in a Custom World.
[*] [b]Settings[/b]: Players can no longer damage their own CAMP objects when PVP is set to “Always” in a Custom World.
[*] [b]Settings[/b]: VATS now correctly targets enemies when the player has no Action Points in Custom Worlds with VATS and Melee AP Cost set to “Zero.”
[*] [b]Settings[/b]: Enemies now correctly stop spawning while the player is on the respawn screen when Proximity Enemy Spawns is enabled in a Custom World.
[*][b] Settings[/b]: Players can no longer place stored C.A.M.P. objects when C.A.M.P. Budget is set to “Zero” in a Custom World.
[*] [b]Settings[/b]: Blueprints that contain floating objects can now be placed in Custom Worlds with Relaxed Building Restrictions enabled. [/list]
[h3]Items[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Aid[/b]: Certain buff timers, like the Lunchbox XP buff, will no longer become out of sync with the server.
[*][b] Aid[/b]: Corrected the description of Toxic Goo to clarify the actual amount of Rad damage the player will take after consuming the item.
[*] [b]Ammo[/b]: The contextual ammo system now drops .45 ammo and Cannonballs in amounts that are more consistent with other ammo types.
[*] [b]Armor[/b]: Life Saving legendary armor now correctly consumes a Stimpak when reviving the player.
[*] [b]Exploit[/b]: Addressed an exploit that allowed players to activate multiple aid items simultaneously.
[*] [b]Exploit[/b]: Addressed an exploit that allowed players to repeatedly and rapidly stack aid item buffs.
[*] [b]Exploit:[/b] Addressed an exploit that allowed players to significantly increase a weapon’s magazine size.
[*] [b]Headwear[/b]: The Covert Scout Armor Mask no longer prevents the Chameleon Mutation from triggering.
[*] [b]Headwear[/b]: The Fireman and Captain Cosmos Helmets now correctly prevent negative effects from airborne hazards.
[*] [b]Melee Weapons[/b]: Attacking with an automatic melee weapon, like the Chainsaw, Drill, or Ripper, now correctly drains Action Points.
[*] [b]Power Armor[/b]: Being melee attacked by another player while wearing Burning, Electrified, Frozen, or Toxic legendary Power Armor will no longer trigger PVP.
[*] [b]Power Armor[/b]: Removing a Fusion Core from Power Armor that has an equipped Jetpack no longer causes that Jetpack to appear to float near the player.
[*] [b]Power Armor[/b]: The Rusty Knuckles Power Armor mod now correctly adds damage when applied to only one arm, rather than requiring both arms to have the mod.
[*] [b]Power Armor[/b]: The Optimized Bracers Power Armor mod’s Action Point cost reduction for Power Attacks now stacks when the mod is applied to both arms, instead of only granting the benefit for one arm.
[*] [b]Power Armor[/b]: Fixed an issue that prevented the Slocum’s Joe Power Armor paint from being applied to Power Armor pieces.
[*] [b]Ranged Weapons[/b]: The Alien Blaster now correctly deals damage to the enemy limbs that it hits, instead of damaging limbs at random.
[*] [b]Ranged Weapons[/b]: Aiming down sights with a weapon that has a scope attached no longer interrupts Jetpack use.
[*] [b]Ranged Weapons[/b]: Gatling weapons no longer reset their windup times if the player attempts to fire immediately after they stop aiming down sights.
[*] [b]Ranged Weapons[/b]: Guns that use Cores as ammo, like the Gatling Plasma and Gatling Laser, can no longer spawn with the Quad legendary attribute.
[*] [b]Ranged Weapons[/b]: Alien Blaster Rounds should now drop from all contextual ammo sources.
[*] [b]Thrown Explosives[/b]: Players can now correctly throw grenades while sprinting. [/list]
[h3]Mutations[/h3] [list]
[*][b]Plague Walker[/b]: The Plague Walker Mutation now correctly deals damage to enemies within its area of effect. [/list]
[h3]NPCs[/h3][list]
[*] [b]Allies[/b]: Daphne and Maul’s C.A.M.P. items can no longer become partially destroyed, which was inconsistent with other Allies’ C.A.M.P. items. [/list]
[h3]Performance & Stability [/h3][list]
[*] [b]Client Stability[/b]: Fixed an issue that could cause duplicate items to appear in the player’s Pip-Boy and result in a client crash.
[*] [b]Client Stability[/b]: Consuming Aid items in rapid succession no longer causes the client to freeze or crash.
[*] [b]Client Stability[/b]: Fixed a client crash that could occur while playing on a team.
[*][b] Server Stability[/b]: Addressed a server crash that could occur during combat. [/list]
[h3]Perk Cards[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Cap Collector[/b]: Looting Brahmin and Chickens no longer causes the fanfare for the Cap Collector Perk Card to appear.
[*] [b]Commando[/b]: Automatic fire and critical hits now work properly in VATS when the Commando Perk Card is equipped.
[*] [b]Daytime Perk Effects[/b]: Perk Cards that activate between 6am and 6pm now correctly work when the player is in an instanced location.
[*] [b]Friendly Fire:[/b] Updated the description of the Friendly Fire Perk Card to clarify that it does not affect Grenades.
[*] [b]Friendly Fire[/b]: The Hellstorm Missile Launcher’s Napalm Payload mod is now correctly affected by the Friendly Fire Perk Card.
[*] [b]Friendly Fire[/b]: Turrets that are owned by NPCs can no longer be healed by the Friendly Fire Perk Card.
[*] [b]Pain Train[/b]: Fixed an issue that prevented Pain Train’s effects from triggering correctly if the player had a weapon drawn in a relaxed state. [/list]
[h3]Survival[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Diseases[/b]: Now have fixed durations and they are no longer affected by the region they are contracted in. Additionally, Fast Traveling to different regions while affected by a Disease no longer alters its duration. [/list]
[h3]User Interface[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Controls[/b]: Fixed an issue that caused the game’s controls to become unresponsive after dying at the very end of an event, which could prevent the player from respawning.
[*] [b]Notifications[/b]: “Crafting item unlocked” notifications that appear after learning plans for various Generators and the Windmill now correctly include the names of those items.
[*] [b]Pip-Boy[/b]: Fixed an issue that could prevent players from scrolling down in the Pip-Boy’s Collections tab on the STAT menu.
[*] [b]Social[/b]: The Social Menu now opens correctly after using the Social Menu hotkey from the game’s Main Menu. [/list]
[h3]World[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Camden Park[/b]: The Mr. Fuzzy Terminal now correctly dispenses rewards after turning in Mr. Fuzzy Tokens to redeem the Super Comic Book option.
[*] [b]Exploit[/b]: Addressed an exploit that enabled players to repeatedly disarm pre-placed Traps. [/list]

notes.title: Fallout 76: Night of the Moth Update Notes – December 8, 2021
notes.content:
The Night of the Moth Update for Fallout 76 arrives today, and it brings the Mothman Equinox Seasonal Event, Fallout 76 Season 7, a wide variety of quality-of-life and Public Event improvements, and much more to the game. Read on to catch all the details.
--- 
[h2]Update Highlights[/h2] [list]
[*] [b]Mothman Equinox[/b]: Until December 21, visit Point Pleasant in the Forest Region every hour to aid The Enlightened in summoning the Wise Mothman to Appalachia and earn new themed rewards!
[*] [b]Season 7 Begins[/b]: Dr. Zorbo will have his revenge against Captain Cosmos—and you’re going to help! Rank up and claim stellar new rewards on the Season 7 Scoreboard, all while traveling the stars to aid Zorbo in assembling a devious crew.
[*] [b]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/b]: We’ve added Legendary Loot Sharing, Nearby Corpse Looting, a Pip-Boy Keyring, and many more community-requested improvements to the game.
[*][b] Public Event Updates[/b]: We’ve made some improvements to help streamline our Public Event system and implemented balance changes for a variety of Public Events.
[*][b] Pirate Radio[/b]: A rogue broadcast is invading Appalachia’s airwaves! Tune your Pip-Boy to Pirate Radio to tap your toes to new tunes, catch radio dramas, and commercials. [/list]
--- 
[h3]Update Version 1.6.2.16[/h3]
PC (Steam): 11.1 GB
--- 
[h2]New Seasonal Event: Mothman Equinox[/h2]
A group of robed travelers have just arrived in Appalachia, and they’ve taken up residence at Point Pleasant to celebrate a dubious occasion known as the Mothman Equinox. Calling themselves “The Enlightened,” this sect of the Wise Mothman’s most devoted followers plan to summon the cryptid through an elaborate ritual. Aid their dark endeavors and fend off rival cultists to earn the Wise Mothman’s favor!
[b]Until December 21, the Mothman Equinox Seasonal Event will take place every hour at the top of the hour at Point Pleasant in the Forest region of Appalachia.[/b]
Begin the event by speaking with Interpreter Clarence on the roof of the Mothman Museum. [list]
[*] Join other Dwellers to aid the Enlightened in completing ceremonial tasks around Point Pleasant, lighting ritual bonfires, and defending against an onslaught of rival Mothman Cultists.
[*] If you manage to finish each objective before its timer expires, head back to the Mothman Museum’s roof to complete the final step of the summoning, commune with the Wise Mothman, and have a chance to earn new themed plans.
[*] While you’re in Point Pleasant, don’t forget to hunt around for ways to learn more about the origins of the mysterious Enlightened. [/list]
As long the Mothman Equinox Seasonal Event is live, you’ll also encounter Cultist High Priests during your adventures throughout Appalachia. Hunt down and dispatch them for more chances to earn Mothman Cult themed rewards, but watch out for their shadow creatures!
--- 
[h2]Fallout 76 Season 7: Zorbo’s Revenge[/h2]
Former (and self-proclaimed) Emperor of the Universe, Dr. Zorbo, has never forgotten his crushing defeat at the hands of Captain Cosmos during “The Legendary Run.” Now, Zorbo seeks to enact revenge by assembling a villainous crew, who will help him build a massive war machine he’ll use to obliterate the Captain. Here’s what’s headed your way during Fallout 76 Season 7, which begins today: [list]
[*] [b]New Scoreboard:[/b] Join forces with Dr. Zorbo on the “Zorbo’s Revenge” Scoreboard as he travels from planet to plant to recruit a crack team that will help him take down Captain Cosmos. Along the way, you’ll be able to earn a host of new in-game rewards this Season, including cosmetics, in-game currencies, consumables, C.A.M.P. objects, and much more!
[*] [b]New Allies:[/b] As you rank up on the Scoreboard, you will also unlock Xerxo and Katherine, two new Allies who can join you in your C.A.M.P., sell you their wares, and offer a daily buff.
[*] [b]To Rank 100, and Beyond!:[/b] As with the previous Season, you can once again surpass Rank 100 to continue earning additional rank-up rewards through the end of Season 7. Each rank you achieve after 100 will award items like Perk Card Packs, consumables, Atoms, and more. [/list]
Catch additional details about Fallout 76 Season 7 by heading to the [url=https://fallout.bethesda.net/en/seasons]Seasons page on Fallout.com[/url], or by [url=https://fallout.bethesda.net/en/article/4oyJy6Thj3TyaatxrnW7KA/fallout-76-inside-the-vault-season-7-scoreboard-rewards-and-community]heading here to read our recent article[/url].
--- 
[h2]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h2]
Community feedback plays an important role in how we approach shaping and leveling-up Fallout 76, and we love reading all of your ideas about what you’d like to see added to the game. With today’s update, we’re implementing a number quality-of-life improvements that have been suggested to us by many of you in the community. We hope you enjoy digging into them in-game, and that you will continue sharing your thoughts with us. [list]
[*] [b]Nearby Corpse Looting[/b]: Unlike many of the creatures who cross your path in the Wasteland, you’re a born survivor! Whenever corpses start to pile up, you’ll no longer need to pick through each and every one to grab your loot. When viewing a fallen enemy’s inventory, you can now see and collect all the goodies that the creatures around you have dropped by hitting the “Nearby Corpses” button. Happy looting!
[*] [b]Legendary Loot Sharing:[/b] Going forward, if you’re within sight range of a legendary creature when it’s killed, you’ll be able to loot it. With this improvement, the days of trying to hit legendary enemies before they die, as well as waiting for other players to get their hits in before you land the killing blow, are over. 
[*] [b]Team XP Sharing[/b]: Sharing is caring, and leveling-up as you adventure with your team is about to get easier than ever. Every enemy that you or a teammate takes down will now grant XP to everyone on the team, so long as they are within sight range of the creature when it dies. 
[*] [b]Build Menu “New” Tab:[/b] We’re adding a “New” tab to your C.A.M.P. build menu that will display any new C.A.M.P. item plans you’ve learned during your current play session, as well as new C.A.M.P. items you’ve unlocked in the Atomic Shop. 
[*] [b]Pip-Boy Keyring[/b]: Tired of all those keys cluttering up your Pip-Boy? Get organized with the Keyring, which is a new item in your “Misc.” inventory tab that stores all of the keys you’ve collected from your adventures in the Wasteland. Click it to view or access any keys in your collection as needed.
[*] [b]Pip-Boy Menu Color Customization:[/b] Show your true colors by changing the hue of your Pip-Boy menus using a new set of customization sliders that we’ve added to the game’s settings.
[*] [b]Ammo Everywhere[/b]: The contextual ammo system has been a very popular aspect of Daily Ops, and so we’d like to bring it to all of Appalachia. Now, all existing sources of ammo, like containers and creature loot, have a chance to drop a small amount of ammo for your currently equipped weapon. [/list]
--- 
[h2]Public Event Updates[/h2]
We’re bringing a variety of improvements to Public Events through some adjustments to the Public Event system itself, the addition of a reward preview to Public Event map descriptions, and a number of balance change across many of the events that are currently available in-game. 
[h3]Public Event System Updates[/h3]
We’ve streamlined the way that Public Events become available in-game by making the cooldown times between events much more consistent. [list]
[*] Public Event start times are now based on real-world time, and a new one will begin every 20 minutes across all worlds.
[*] Each world’s next Public Event is selected at random. In addition, a Public Event can no longer appear twice in a row in the same world. [/list]
Seasonal Public Events that begin every hour, like Grahm’s Meat-Cook or Mothman Equinox, will take priority over normal Public Events.
We’ve adjusted the timers for the following Public Events to help them fit within the 20-minute Public Event time cadence: [list]
[*] Campfire Tales 
[*] Distinguished Guests
[*] Feed the People
[*] Heart of the Swamp
[*] Line in the Sand
[*] One Violent Night
[*] Path to Enlightenment
[*] Project Paradise
[*] Radiation Rumble
[*] Tea Time
[*] The Motherlode 
[*] Uranium Fever [/list]
A few Public Events, like Scorched Earth and A Colossal Problem, have special requirements in order to start and can be triggered at any time. That has not changed, and these events are not part of the timed Public Event rotation.
[h3]Public Event Reward Previews[/h3]
As mentioned above, you can now preview the rewards that are up for grabs at each Public Event directly from the event’s description on the Map. 
Select an available Public Event on the Map to display its description, and view some of the big-ticket items that are possible to earn if you manage to complete that event successfully.
[h3]Public Event Balance Adjustments[/h3]
Previously, some of our Public Events could be a little too difficult, end in failure too suddenly, or even last too long. We’re implementing balance changes for a number of Public Events to help smooth out some of these rough spots and improve the experience of playing through them. 
[b]Campfire Tales[/b]
The campfire often died down too quickly, which could cause the event to fail more easily than we’d like. Now, the campfire will burn a little longer, giving you and your event mates some more time to feed the flames.
[b]Free Range[/b]
The Brahmin during Free Range were too fragile, so we’ve beefed up their resistances to help them survive more easily (though they will still need you to defend them).
[b]Guided Meditation[/b][list]
[*] Feral Ghouls now consistently run toward and attack the speakers, preventing an issue where they could remain idle in the parking lot.
[*] Ghouls may sometimes still stand around if they don’t sniff out new prey right away, but they will always be much closer to the action.
[*] We’ve reduced Ghouls’ overall difficulty during Guided Meditation to account for their increased speaker-busting effectiveness. [/list]
[b]Line in the Sand: [/b] [list]
[*] Line in the Sand was taking a bit too long to come to an end. It now has an overall time limit of 10 minutes, and uses timers to determine how long Scorched attack waves last, rather than requiring you to kill all enemies in a given wave. These changes should help the event flow more smoothly and reduce downtime throughout. 
[*] Upon reaching the event’s time limit, it will not fail so long as the generator is still standing. You will receive more rewards, however, if you managed to defeat all of the enemy waves. [/list]
[b]Project Paradise[/b] [list]
[*] To help reduce the event’s difficulty, we’re lowering the amount of food required to level-up each biome’s creatures to 15 per rank. 
[*] We’re also adding some more resistances to friendly creatures that spawn during the event. 
[*] Project Paradise no longer ends in failure if you do not manage to kill the Alpha creatures. To succeed, players only need to defend the friendly creatures. However, rewards will be reduced if the Alphas are still alive at the end of the event. [/list]
[b]Radiation Rumble: [/b] [list]
[*] To encourage players to participate in the ore collection objective more often, we’re lowering the requirements to 5, 15, 30, and 50 ore for reward tiers one through four, respectively.
[*] Radiation Rumble now has an overall time limit of 8 minutes, even if you have already reached the final ore collection tier. This way, you can continue defending against enemy attack waves until the event concludes. 
[*] We’ve also lowered the spawn rate of non-Ghoul enemies at certain Ore thresholds to prevent overwhelming enemy numbers.
[*] Finally, we’ve doubled the Scavengers’ resistances to make them more survivable. [/list]
[b]Swarm of Suitors[/b] [list]
[*] We’ve addressed a number of bugs that could prevent players from receiving the highest tier of rewards and from successfully completing the event. We’ve also made some design adjustments to streamline the event.
[*] Swarm of Suitors has been redesigned to focus on killing Mirelurks within a certain amount of time, rather than preventing them from reaching the island.
[*] Now, players must kill all Mirelurks in each of three attack waves before the objective timer expires. If they don’t manage to defeat an attack wave in time, a Mirelurk Queen will spawn and the event will end in failure. [/list]
[b]Tea Time[/b] [list]
[*] Tea Time could end in failure too quickly at times, in part due to some of the pipes breaking too easily. As a result, we’ve increased the health for two of the three pipes so that they match the sturdiest one.
[*] We’ve also tuned enemy attack waves to spawn creatures at a more consistent frequency to keep up the action. 
[*] Additionally, Rad Ants and Ticks no longer spawn enemy waves that attack the pipes. However, Rad Ants and Bloatflies now spawn in separate enemy waves that focus their attacks on players. [/list]
--- 
[h2]Tune Into Pirate Radio![/h2]
It seems someone out there in the Wasteland has found a way to hijack the airwaves to begin broadcasting their very own Pirate Radio Station! Open your Pip-Boy and tune into the new station to tap your toes to hours of new “muzak,”jingles, and catch a blast from the past with radio dramas and commercials from life before the bombs dropped. The audio interloper behind this rogue station has yet to reveal their identity, and until they do, you can at least enjoy some fresh tunes during your adventures in Appalachia.
--- 
[h2]Bug Fixes & Additional Improvements[/h2]
[h3]Art[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Apparel:[/b] The player’s hands no longer clip into rifles and shotguns while wearing the Crypt Crook outfit.
[*] [b]Apparel: [/b]Blood Eagle Charmer, Treasure Hunter, and Radstag Hide outfits now correctly hide underarmor while equipped.
[*] [b]Graphics:[/b] Players who are killed by a Flamer will no longer continue to display flame visual effects after respawning.
[*] [b]Graphics:[/b] Fixed an issue that could cause enemy and player corpses to temporarily become invisible after being killed. [/list]
[h3]C.A.M.P.s & Workshops[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Displays: [/b]The Pepper Shaker can now be displayed in the Heavy Weapons Stand.
[*] [b]Fences:[/b] Red Cedar Hedges placed in a teammate’s C.A.M.P. can now be moved, stored, scrapped, etc., by the C.A.M.P. owner.
[*] [b]Flags:[/b] The Clean U.S. Wall and Pole Flags have been hand-washed with care and are now much cleaner than before.
[*] [b]Floors:[/b] C.A.M.P. budget consumed by the Haunted House Floor is now consistent with other types of flooring.
[*] [b]Misc. Structures:[/b] Reduced the C.A.M.P. budget consumed by many large neon signs and billboards.
[*] [b]Roofs:[/b] C.A.M.P. budget consumed by the Haunted House Roof is now consistent with other types of roofing.
[*] [b]Roofs:[/b] A windowless variation of the Haunted House Roof Slant has been added to the Haunted House building set.
[*] [b]Stash Boxes:[/b] Implemented a fix to reduce instances where the Secret Stash Bookcase and other Stash Boxes could appear open even though they are closed.
[*] [b]Tables:[/b] The Wavy Willard’s Round Deck Table now correctly appears in the “Tables” category in the build menu.
[*][b] Walls:[/b] Powered Doors with Keypad access now correctly snap to foundations.
[*] [b]Walls:[/b] Haunted House right fascia pieces no longer flip after applying wallpaper to them.
[*] [b]Wall Décor:[/b] Season Gameboards no longer each have their own entry in the build menu, and instead appear as variants in a single row under Wall Décor.
[*] [b]Workbenches[/b]: Attempting to use a Power Armor Station that has been built close to a wall or another object no longer results in a “Waiting for response from server” error message. [/list]
[h3]Challenges[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Combat:[/b] The “Repair 76 Swords” lifetime challenge now correctly awards Atoms when completed.
[*] [b]Social:[/b] The “Revive 76 Players” lifetime challenge now correctly awards Atoms when completed.
[*] [b]Social:[/b] The “Use Photomode at Burdette Manor” subchallenge for the “Use Photomode around the Forest Region” social challenge has been corrected to “Use Photomode at the Kill Box.”
[*] [b]Weekly:[/b] Killing a Hermit Crab now progresses the “Kill Huge Creatures” challenge.
[*] [b]World:[/b] Building a wood instrument now correctly progresses the “Possum: Musician” challenge. [/list]
[h3]Combat[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Enemy Health:[/b] Implemented a fix to significantly reduce enemy health “rubber banding” that could occur when damaging them with certain weapons, like the Pepper Shaker. [/list]
[h3]Daily Ops[/h3][list]
[*] [b]Arktos Pharma:[/b] Adjusted the spawn location for Daily Ops inside Arktos Pharma so that players have more room to move around and are less likely to start the Op by accident. [/list]
[h3]Events & Quests [/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Loading Screens:[/b] When fast traveling to a Public Event, loading screens now correctly display additional information about that event.
[*] [b]The Motherlode:[/b] Melody Larkin will no longer warn the player about church bells in Charleston after completing the Motherlode event. Your reign of terror has ended, Melody.
[*] [b]Project Beanstalk:[/b] Pharmabot-JD7E no longer becomes hostile toward the player after being hit by NPCs during the event.
[*] [b]Vital Equipment:[/b] Players now receive the proper amount of reputation with Foundation when choosing to donate the recovered item. [/list]
[h3]Fallout Worlds[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Menus[/b]: The Shared Worlds menu now reflects changes to a shared Custom World more quickly after the world owner makes settings adjustments.
[*] [b]Settings:[/b] Crafting quest items with Free Workbench Crafting enabled no longer consumes standard crafting materials.
[*] [b]Settings[/b]: When PVP is set to “Always,” the players in that world will now correctly be marked as hostile toward one another.
[*] [b]Private Adventure:[/b] Fixed an issue that could prevent players from joining Private Adventure worlds from the main menu while on a team. [/list]
[h3]Items[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Aid: [/b]Addiction debuffs are now correctly suppressed after consuming an item the character is addicted to.
[*] [b]Ammo:[/b] Fixed an issue that could result in less ammo being created than expected when attempting to craft large amounts of high-caliber ammo with the Ammosmith Perk and Ammo Factory Legendary Perk equipped.
[*] [b]Apparel:[/b] The Hooded Rags outfit no longer removes armor or underarmor when equipped.
[*] [b]Apparel:[/b] The Wrapped Cap can now be worn with eyewear and some face coverings, and no longer removes facial hair when equipped.
[*][b]Backpacks:[/b] The name of the player's backpack now updates correctly after applying the Corvega skin.
[*] [b]Exploit:[/b] Addressed an issue that could be exploited to consume fewer materials when crafting legendary items.
[*] [b]Junk:[/b] Lanterns now display a preview image when inspected.
[*] [b]Melee Weapons: [/b]The Valorous Alistair Sword Skin can now be applied to many additional one-handed melee weapons.
[*] [b]Misc:[/b] Scrap Assaultron Heads no longer appear upside down in Display Cases.
[*] [b]Misc:[/b] Cold Steel Beer Steins now face the same direction as other Steins when placed in a Beer Stein Display Case.
[*] [b]Mods:[/b] Applying a Jetpack mod to a Secret Service Chest Piece no longer causes it to turn invisible after logging out and back in.
[*] [b]Mods:[/b] The Communist and Red Communist Jetpack mods can now be applied to Ultracite and Raider Power Armor torso pieces.
[*] [b]Mods:[/b] Fixed an issue that allowed players to apply a Jetpack to Excavator Power Armor.
[*] [b]Mods:[/b] Fixed an issue that could prevent a Minigun with the Shredder mod from dealing damage if the player had 5mm ammo in their inventory.
[*] [b]Mods:[/b] The Power Armor Helmet Targeting HUD mod now correctly highlights hostile NPCs who had been passive before the player initiated combat with them.
[*] [b]Power Armor:[/b] The Northern Lights Power Armor skin can now be applied to all types of Power Armor.
[*] [b]Ranged Weapons:[/b] The Salvaged Assaultron Head now deals the correct amount of damage per charge when fired in VATS.
[*] [b]Ranged Weapons:[/b] Fixed an issue that could prevent weapon bash attacks from dealing damage after applying a mod that increased the weapon’s melee damage.
[*] [b]Ranged Weapons:[/b] Flares now ignite properly when fired into the terrain or at a structure.
[*] [b]Survival Tents:[/b] The Tinker’s Workbench and Scrapbox are now oriented correctly in the APC Survival Tent. [/list]
[h3]Localization[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Achievements[/b]: Steel Reign Achievements now have proper translations in the Simplified Chinese game client.
[*] [b]Quests[/b]: Corrected missing characters in the “Unsolved: Missing Girls” note during the “Unsolved: Picnic Panic” quest in the Simplified Chinese game client.
[*] [b]Quests[/b]: Corrected missing characters in the “Suspicious death of Alicia Shay” note during the “Treasure Unknown” quest in the Japanese game client. [/list]
[h3]NPCs[/h3] [list]
[*][b]Allies:[/b] The Settler Forager Ally can once again give Daily Quests to the C.A.M.P. owner.
[*][b]Minerva: [/b]Item Plans and Recipes the player has already learned will no longer appear to them as purchasable in Minerva’s inventory. [/list]
[h3]Performance & Stability [/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Client Stability: [/b]Fixed a crash that could occur during normal gameplay.
[*] [b]Client Stability[/b]: Fixed a crash that could occur when fighting a Daily Ops boss.
[*] [b]Client Stability[/b]: Addressed an audio issue that could result in a client crash.
[*] [b]Client Stability[/b]: Fixed an issue that could cause the client to crash after fast traveling.
[*] [b]Client Stability[/b]: Applying mods to laser and plasma weapons no longer causes the Russian game client to crash.
[*] [b]Server Stability[/b]: Fixed an issue that could cause a server crash during normal gameplay.
[*] [b]Server Stability:[/b] Fixed a server crash that could occur during combat.
[*] [b]Server Stability[/b]: Addressed an issue that could result in a server crash during the Meat Week Seasonal Event. [/list]
[h3]Perks[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Friendly Fire:[/b] Allied NPCs can now be healed using the Friendly Fire Perk. [/list]
[h3]User Interface[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Controls[/b]: The quick-swap button can now be used to switch to non-offensive weapons, like the Pro-Snap Deluxe Camera.
[*] [b]Main Menu[/b]: Fixed visual issues that could occur after idling on the main menu for an extended period of time. [/list]
[h3]World [/h3] [list] 
[*] [b]Ultracite Veins[/b]: Mining Ultracite Veins near Fissure Sites no longer causes Scorched to spawn. [/list]

notes.title: Fallout 76 Update Notes – October 19, 2021
notes.content:
Halloween is descending on Appalachia with our latest update for Fallout 76, which arrives today. Scare up some fun over the next two weeks by hunting down Spooky Scorched, trick-or-treating at others’ C.A.M.P.s, and by giving out candy from your own home. Read on to catch all the details.
--- 
[h2]Update Highlights[/h2] [list]
[*] [b]Spooky Scorched:[/b] Some of the Scorched are celebrating the Halloween season by dressing in costume and dropping special loot!
[*] [b]Pass Out Candy from your Haunted House[/b]: Claim a free Spooky Candy Bowl from the Atomic Shop, place it in your C.A.M.P., and fill it with Mystery Candy for trick-or-treaters to complete Challenges and earn rewards.
[*] [b]Trick-or-Treat Around Appalachia[/b]: Step into your favorite costume and collect Mystery Candy from other players’ C.A.M.P.s to receive additional Challenge rewards. [/list]
--- 
[h2]Update Version 1.6.1.18[/h2]
[b]PC (Steam)[/b]: 9.3 GB
--- 
[h2]Spooky Scorched Are on the Prowl[/h2]
Halloween is almost here, and some of the Scorched are getting into the spirit of the season by dressing in their most festive costumes as they creep around Appalachia! [b]From now until November 2[/b], whenever you spot “Spooky Scorched” during your adventures, or hear their spine-chilling holiday sounds, it’s time to go on the hunt. [list]
[*] Spooky Scorched will spawn as 1, 2, or 3-star legendaries, which means you’ll receive a legendary item every time you take one down. 
[*] You’ll also receive a [b]Spooky Treat Bag[/b], which you can open to get some goodies like consumables, ammo, and a chance at some Halloween themed Plans.
[*] Finally, you’ll receive a piece of Mystery Candy that you can eat to receive one of five random buffs, which may include stat boosts, or even Nukashine-like effects. [i][b]TIP:[/b] While it can be tempting to devour all your [b]Mystery Candy[/b] right away, you may want to hold on to a few pieces so that you can take part in our Trick-or-Treating event this year (more on that below).[/i]
[*]Please also note that, like the Holiday Scorched, Spooky Scorched will not spawn inside of interiors.[/list]
--- 
[h2]Trick or Treat![/h2]
The Scorched won’t be the only ones haunting the Wasteland this Halloween! From now until November 2, you can dress up in costume to go trick-or-treating around Appalachia with your friends, and even give out candy to trick-or-treaters who visit your home. Along the way, you’ll be able to complete new trick-or-treating Challenges to earn rewards.

[h3]Pass Out Candy to Trick-or-Treaters[/h3]
[b]Visit the Atomic Shop to claim a free Spooky Candy Bowl before November 2[/b], build it in your C.A.M.P., and fill it with Mystery Candy for trick-or-treaters to enjoy. [list]
[*] Get your hands on Mystery Candy by looting Spooky Scorched, or buying some with Caps from train station vendors around Appalachia.
[*] [b]TIP[/b]: Place your Spooky Candy Bowl in an obvious spot in your C.A.M.P. where trick-or-treaters can easily find it.
[*] Please also note that Spooky Candy Bowls cannot be placed inside Shelters. [/list]
Your C.A.M.P. will display a pumpkin icon on the Map once you’ve added Mystery Candy to your Spooky Candy Bowl, which will let other Dwellers know they are welcome to stop by for a treat. [list]
[*] If your candy bowl is empty, the pumpkin icon will stop appearing for your C.A.M.P. until you refill it.
[*] Each trick-or-treater can only take one piece of candy per hour from your candy bowl, so there’s no need to worry about anyone swiping more than their fair share. [/list]
Over the next two weeks, you will receive Daily and Weekly Challenges to give out candy, which you can complete to earn rewards! [list]
[*] [b]Daily Challenges[/b] will grant you one of several possible rewards, like a consumable item, Perk Card Pack, Lunchbox, Repair Kit, or some S.C.O.R.E.
[*] [b]Weekly Challenges[/b] to give candy to trick-or-treaters can award S.C.O.R.E., rare crafting materials, or even Halloween costumes. Complete both Weekly Challenges and you’ll also receive a new Popcorn Machine for your C.A.M.P.! [/list]
[h3]Go On the Hunt for Candy![/h3]
Dust off your favorite costume, grab a few friends, and leave space in your pack for plenty of candy, because it’s time to trick or treat your way around the Wasteland! [list]
[*] Open the Map to spot C.A.M.P.s that have a pumpkin icon, which indicates that the owner currently has a Spooky Candy Bowl stocked up with Mystery Candy. [/list]
Each day until November 2, you will receive a new Daily Challenge to trick or treat at other Dwellers’ C.A.M.P.s. [list]
[*] Like the Daily Challenges to give out candy, completing each trick-or-treating Daily will net you one of several rewards, including consumables, a Perk Card Pack, Lunchbox, Repair Kit, or some S.C.O.R.E. [/list]
Make sure you’re wearing a costume when you take Mystery Candy from someone else’s Spooky Candy Bowl to ensure you’ll receive Challenge credit. [list]
[*] There are many different costume options available in-game, such as those you can find during your adventures, a variety of Unstoppables-themed rank-up rewards from the Season 6 Scoreboard, as well as costumes you can purchase in the Atomic Shop. [/list]
--- 
[h2]Bug Fixes & Additional Improvements[/h2]
[h3]Art[/h3][list] 
[*] [b]Apparel:[/b] Fixed an issue that could partially obstruct the screen in first-person view while wearing the American Patriot Suit.
[*] [b]Apparel[/b]: Equipping the King Grognak Outfit while wearing the Grognak Sidekick Underarmor no longer turns the player’s hands invisible.
[*] [b]Headwear[/b]: The Mothman Gas Mask no longer clips into female characters’ faces.
[*] [b]Junk[/b]: Fuel Tanks now correctly display preview images when viewed or inspected in the inventory.
[*] [b]Power Armor[/b]: Reduced the amount of screen space taken up by the Park Ranger Power Armor’s forearms when wielding heavy weapons in first-person view, so that it is consistent with other Power Armors.
[*] [b]Power Armor[/b]: Park Ranger Power Armor pieces now have proper interior textures when inspected in the inventory.
[*] [b]Weapons[/b]: The Grelok Sorcerer Staff and Stanley Skins now correctly appear when applied to Grognak’s Axe.
[*] [b]Weapons[/b]: Improved the idle animation for the Grognak’s Other Axe Skin while in first-person view.
[*] [b]Weapons[/b]: Shortened the rebar on the Death’s Breath Flamer Skin to reduce the amount of screen space it takes up when playing in first-person view.
[*] [b]Weapons:[/b] The correct reload animation now plays when reloading a Gatling Gun that has an Extra Large Magazine Mod while wearing Power Armor.[/list]
[h3]C.A.M.P.s & Workshops[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Collectron Station[/b]: Moving a Collectron Station in C.A.M.P. before looting items it contained no longer prevents those items from appearing in the Station’s transfer menu.
[*] [b]Displays[/b]: Corrected the placement of Grognak’s Other Axe when displayed in High-Powered and Magnetic Weapon Racks.
[*] [b]Mobile Home Trailer:[/b] Players can no longer build multiple Mobile Home Doors in the same Mobile Home Trailer’s doorway.
[*] [b]Stairs[/b]: Snapping two Haunted House Stairs to each other no longer prevents players from walking up both sets of stairs.
[*] [b]Survival Tent[/b]: The Scrap Box in the Abandoned Shack Survival Tent now correctly faces the player. [/list]
[h3]Daily Ops[/h3][list]
[*] [b]Double Mutations[/b]: 2x currency rewards no longer appear halved in the Operation Report after completing a Double Mutation Daily Op. [/list]
[h3]Events & Quests [/h3][list]
[*] [b]Missing Persons[/b]: The “Find clues to where the Raiders are” objective now correctly progresses after opening the doors leading to the top floor of AMS Headquarters.
[*] [b]Missing Persons:[/b] Marcia no longer occasionally disappears during combat. [/list]
[h3]Items[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Backpacks[/b]: The Hazmat Meat Cooler Backpack now appears centered on the player’s back.
[*] [b]Crafting[/b]: Fixed an issue on PC that could cause players to craft lower-level items than intended.
[*] [b]Explosive Bait[/b]: Fixed an issue that caused players to take damage from Explosive Bait when they were not currently engaged in PVP combat with the player who threw it.
[*] [b]Headwear[/b]: Fixed an issue that prevented Communist Commander Hats from appearing in players’ inventories.
[*] [b]Legendary Armor[/b]: Auto-Stim Legendary Armor no longer automatically uses Stimpaks if a highly-radiated player’s available health is full.
[*] [b]Legendary Crafting[/b]: Progress will now be saved after crafting a legendary item at a Workbench.
[*] [b]Ranged Weapons[/b]: Laser Rifles with an attached Sniper Barrel Mod now fire correctly in third-person view while wearing Power Armor.
[*] [b]Unarmed Melee Weapons[/b]: Crafting a legendary “Face Breaker” Power Fist now correctly requires 2 Legendary Modules. The ability to craft this item has been re-enabled at Weapons Workbenches. 
[*] [b]Underarmor[/b]: Players can now apply Casual Mods to all Season 6 Sidekick Underarmors. [/list]
[h3]Localization[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Events[/b]: The Monster Mash event’s map description, quest description, and quest tracker are now correctly translated in non-English game clients.
[*] [b]Quest[/b]s: Meg’s voice lines during the “Siding with Crater” quest are now correctly translated in the Japanese game client. [/list]
[h3]Performance & Stability [/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Client Stability[/b]: Addressed an issue that could cause the PlayStation client to crash after placing a Junkyard Fountain in C.A.M.P.
[*] [b]Client Stability[/b]: Fixed a crash that could occur when repeatedly switching tabs in the Pip-Boy.
[*] [b]Performance[/b]: Fixed an issue in which the crafting menu could take a long time to open under certain conditions. [/list]
[h3]Sound[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Main Menu[/b]: Updated the Main Menu music for PlayStation and Xbox versions of the game so that it is consistent with other platforms. [/list]
[h3]User Interface[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Atomic Shop[/b]: Corrected an issue that prevented some emotes from playing their icon animations when selected in the Atomic Shop.
[*] [b]Atomic Shop[/b]: Inspecting certain Emotes and Player Icons in the Atomic Shop no longer causes item descriptions to disappear the Shop’s menus.
[*] [b]Pip-Boy[/b]: Opening a Holotape in the Pip-Boy and then switching to or from Quick-Boy view no longer causes the Pip-Boy UI to overlap the Holotape’s content. [/list]
[h3]World [/h3][list]
[*] [b]Collision[/b]: Addressed a number of objects throughout Appalachia that players could partially clip into or walk through. 
[*] [b]Pathing[/b]: Addressed a number of locations throughout Appalachia where players or creatures could become stuck. [/list]

notes.title: Fallout 76: Fallout Worlds Update Notes – September 8, 2021
notes.content:
The Fallout Worlds Update is arriving today, and it brings the Public and Custom Worlds game modes to Fallout 76. We’re also expanding on Daily Ops with Double Mutation Weekends, new locations, a new enemy group, and more. Read on to catch all the details!
--- 
[h2]Update Highlights[/h2] [list]
[*] [b]New Ways to Play:[/b] Experience Appalachia like never before with Public Worlds! Each Public World features specialized game settings, fit to a theme, and they are available to all players.
[*] [b]Your World, Made to Order:[/b] Fallout 1st Members can now create Custom Worlds to build their own personalized versions of Appalachia using a wide variety of modifiable game settings.
[*] [b]Daily Ops Expansion:[/b] Our latest expansion for Daily Ops introduces Double Mutation events every other weekend, a new enemy group, three new locations, and new rewards!
[*] [b]Nuclear Winter Rewards:[/b] Nuclear Winter Mode has been deactivated. Perk Coins based on progression have been added to players’ accounts, and Nuclear Winter cosmetics can now be earned from Public Events. [/list]
--- 
[h2]Update Version 1.6.0.17[/h2] [list]
[*] PC (Steam): 16.1GB [/list]
--- 
[h2]Season 5 Extended Two Weeks[/h2]
We've discovered an issue affecting Season 5 rank-ups, where players in some cases are unable to claim the rewards for ranks they purchased using Atoms. This does not affect rank-ups achieved by earning S.C.O.R.E., but we are working hard to get this fixed up as soon as possible so that all players can enjoy the rewards they've earned. 
[b]As a result, we have extended Season 5 by two weeks, until September 21.[/b] During the first week, rank-up purchases using Atoms will be disabled while we work to resolve the underlying issue, and you can continue to rank-up by earning S.C.O.R.E. from Daily and Weekly Challenges. During the second week, we will release our fix and re-enable rank-up purchases so that everyone has plenty of time to claim any rewards they unlocked during this two week period.
We know that many players in the community are excited to kick off Season 6, and we are too. However, we want to make sure all players can access their Season 5 rewards before we roll into the new Season. Thank you very much, and we apologize for any inconvenience.
[h2]Introducing: Fallout Worlds[/h2]
With this update for Fallout 76, we’re introducing Fallout Worlds, which offers players the ability to experience the game in unique new ways with two new game modes: Public Worlds and Custom Worlds.
--- 
[h3]Public Worlds[/h3] 
The new Public Worlds mode will help you shake up your normal gameplay by offering special worlds that have a pre-selected group of Fallout Worlds settings enabled, fit to a theme. [i][b]All players can join Public Worlds[/b] to dive into an Appalachia that’s wildly different from Adventure Mode.[/i]
One Public World will be available to players at a time. Currently, we are planning to rotate Public Worlds once per month so that you can regularly try out a variety of different experiences. However, rotation frequency may change in the future based on community feedback and other factors. 
Here are the first five Public Worlds that you will be able to check out in-game. As voted on by our Public Test Server participants, we’re starting with “Happy Builder,” and will rotate through the rest in the following order:
[list]
[*] [b]Happy Builder:[/b] Reduced C.A.M.P. placement restrictions, relaxed building restrictions, all Map locations discovered, and PvP has been disabled.
[*] [b]High Risk:[/b] No Fast Travel, always-on PVP, players drop additional loot on death, free workbench crafting, and legendary item attributes have been disabled.
[*][b]Dweller Must Die[/b]: Greatly increased enemy difficulty, increased damage, increased equipment durability, and “Dark Bog” weather effects.
[*] [b]Quantum World[/b]: Max jump height, no fall damage, nuked creatures and flora, and “Quantum Storm” weather.
[*][b]Butcher’s Delight[/b]: Infinite ammo, no VATS or melee attack AP costs, and enhanced dismemberment. [/list]
[h3]Custom Worlds[/h3]
Players with active Fallout 1st memberships can now choose the Custom Worlds option from the Play menu to create a new type of world where they can adjust a wide variety of different settings to create an Appalachia that’s tailored to their liking. [list]
[*] To create a Custom World, click “Play” from the Main Menu, select Custom World, hit “Select World Template,” and then start tinkering with settings you’d like to try out.
[*] Up to seven friends can join you in your Custom World, for a total of eight players per World.
[*] [b]Please Note[/b]: Private Worlds mode has been renamed to “Private Adventure” with today’s update to better differentiate it from Custom Worlds mode. [/list]
While creating your Custom World, you can choose among a broad array of customization settings and let your imagination run wild with the possibilities! Here are some of the options at your disposal: [list]
[*] [b]Workshop[/b]: Build in previously restricted areas, disable the need for electricity, increase your C.A.M.P. budget and build height, relax building restrictions, and more.
[*] [b]Combat[/b]: Infinite enemy spawns, alter PvP rules, adjust enemy difficulty, give yourself infinite ammo, change item durability, and more.
[*] [b]General[/b]: Disable Fast Travel or make it free. Choose special weather effects, including Radstorms and Nuke Zones, as well as new weather effects, like Quantum Storm and Dark Bog. Add filters for a unique view of Appalachia, adjust jump height, fall damage, or even the consequences on death.
[*] [b]Please note[/b]: Some Custom World settings may impact your game client’s performance. However, you are still free to use them, and can always enable or disable them again as needed. [/list]
Currently, you can save a Custom World you’ve created in one of three available slots, and you can select one of them to set it as your active Custom World. [list]
[*] You can edit your Custom Worlds after you’ve finished creating them, so even if you’ve filled all three Custom World slots, you can still change them up as needed. [/list]
If you are a Fallout 1st member and you have played in a friend’s Custom World previously, you will be able to log into it — even if the World owner is offline. [list]
[*] To do this, select Custom Worlds from the Play menu, click “View Worlds,” select your friend’s World from the “Shared World” section and set it to “Active.” You can then play in that World by selecting Custom Worlds from the Play menu. [/list]
If you are not currently an active Fallout 1st member, don’t worry. You can still join your friends who are Fallout 1st members in the Custom Worlds that they’ve set up while they are online.
[h3]Character Progression[/h3]
The progress each of your characters make in Public or Custom Worlds is specific to those worlds, and is completely separate from Adventure Mode. [list]
[*] You can clone your Adventure Mode character for use in a Public or Custom World at any time, and you can have up to 5 Fallout World characters at a time.
[*] If you have reached your 5 character limit, characters can be manually unlinked from Public or Custom worlds at any time.
[*] Your character progress in a Public World will remain available as long as that Public World is still available for play. [/list]
Additionally, please note that Challenges cannot be completed, and you will not earn S.C.O.R.E. while playing in a Public or Custom World.
If you would like to learn additional details about Fallout Worlds, you can head here to read [url=https://bethesda.net/en/article/1CaYL1x4wgGui3mKFKGLxZ/announcing-fallout-worlds]our article on Bethesda.net[/url] or read through [url=https://fallout.bethesda.net/en/fallout1st]our FAQ on the Fallout 1st website[/url].--- 
--- 
[h2]Daily Ops Expansion[/h2]
Our latest expansion for Daily Ops brings a new weekend event that amps up the challenge, but offers increased rewards. Read on for a brief overview of everything we’re adding to Daily Ops, including Double Mutation Weekend events!
[h3]Double Mutation Weekend Events[/h3]
During Double Mutation weekends, Daily Ops will be randomized each day with enemies who have one of eight unique combinations of two different Mutations.[list] 
[*] Double Mutation Weekend events will typically run every other weekend, from Thursday to Monday, starting and ending at the normal Daily Ops reset time. [/list]
While a Double Mutation event is active, daring adventurers who are willing to delve into Daily Ops will earn the following increased rewards: [list]
[*] 2 - 6 Legendary Cores for the first and all subsequent Elder Tier completions
[*] Double XP during every Daily Ops playthrough
[*] Double the in-game currency rewards from every Daily Ops playthrough [/list]
[h3]Double the Danger![/h3]
Check out the full list of potential double Mutations that enemies can sport during the new weekend events, so that you know what you’ll be up against. [list]
[*] [b]Blistering Cold:[/b] “Blistering” enemies have the Freezing Touch and Swift-Footed Mutations 
[*] [b]Chilling Mend[/b]: “Chilling” enemies have the Freezing Touch and Group Regeneration Mutations
[*] [b]Clouded Toxins:[/b] “Clouded” enemies have the Active Camouflage and Toxic Blood Mutations
[*] [b]Relentless:[/b] “Relentless” enemies have the Resilient and Group Regeneration Mutations
[*] [b]Stinging Frost[/b]: “Stinging” enemies have the Freezing Touch and Toxic Blood Mutations
[*] [b]Swift Stalker:[/b] “Stalking” enemies have the Active Camouflage and Swift-Footed Mutations
[*] [b]Unstable[/b]: “Unstable” enemies have the Volatile and Swift-Footed Mutations
[*] [b]Vaporous[/b]: “Vaporous” enemies have the Volatile and Active Camouflage Mutations [/list]
[h3]New Enemies[/h3]
We’ve added Communists to the pool of randomized enemy groups you may encounter in any Daily Ops mode.
[h3]New Locations[/h3]
Fight your way through Arktos Pharma Biome Lab, Watoga High School, and Uncanny Caverns, all of which have been added to the randomized pool of locations for Daily Ops.
[h3]Rewards Updates[/h3]
In this update for Daily Ops, we’re adding Plans for two legendary weapons, new themed cosmetics, and more. Check out the full list below for new rewards you’ll be able to earn by completing 
Daily Ops: [list]
[*] Plan: Arctic Marine Armor
[*] Plan: Mechanic’s Best Friend Pipe Wrench
[*] Plan: Sole Survivor Lever Action Rifle
[*] Outfit: Black Hazmat Suit
[*] Plan: Mirelurk King Tube
[*] Blood Eagle Skull Lord Outfit
[*] Blood Eagle Skull Lord Helmet
[*] Blood Eagle Auto-Grenade Launcher Paint [/list]
[h3]Additional Daily Ops Improvements[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Enemies[/b]: We’ve addressed a number of issues that were affecting Mothman Hatchlings, and these cute-but-deadly creatures will once again appear when Cultists are the current Daily Ops enemy group.
[*] [b]Mutations[/b]: “Volatile” enemy explosion damage has been adjusted, and now does health percentage-based damage that can be partially mitigated by anti-explosion effects.
[*] [b]Reset Timer[/b]: We’ve added a timer so you can more easily check when the next Daily Ops reset will occur. You can find the timer in the “Intel” section of the detailed Daily Ops menu after selecting a Daily Op from the World Activity Tracker. [/list]
--- 
[h2]Nuclear Winter Mode Rewards[/h2]
With the arrival of today’s update, we have removed the Nuclear Winter game mode from Fallout 76. Alongside this change, we’re granting rewards to all players who had completed at least one Nuclear Winter match, and making many of the mode’s progression rewards available in Adventure Mode.
[b]Nuclear Winter Pennant:[/b] All players who completed at least one Nuclear Winter match will receive a Nuclear Winter themed Pennant they can build in their CAMPs. The Pennant will be added to your Wall Décor category in the build menu within two weeks following today’s update.
[b]Perk Coins[/b]: With today’s update, we’re granting Perk Coins to players based on their progression in Nuclear Winter Mode so that you can give your Legendary Perk Card collection a boost. [list]
[*] You will receive 6 Perk Coins per Nuclear Winter Perk Card you earned from the Nuclear Winter progression system.
[*] You will also get 1 Perk Coin per Overseer Ticket you earned.
[*] These Perk Coins have already been added to your account, and will be available to you as soon as you log in. [/list]
[b]Cosmetic Rewards:[/b] Many of the cosmetic rewards that could be earned by climbing Overseer Ranks in Nuclear Winter are now available in Adventure Mode as rewards that you can claim by completing Public Events. Here is the current list of events where you have a chance to earn these cosmetics: [list]
[*] A Colossal Problem
[*] Encryptid
[*] Project Paradise
[*] Scorched Earth
[*] Limited Time Events: Festive Scorched & Treasure Hunter [/list]
[b]Exclusive Rewards: [/b]Nuclear Winter Trophies and Statues will remain exclusive to players who earned them by climbing the ranks in the Nuclear Winter progression system. 
To learn more about our reasoning behind this change, you can read through [url=https://fallout.bethesda.net/en/article/4fVBSxmrtEqLyJc8kNv0dD/fallout-76-inside-the-vault-join-us-for-e3-free-play-week-and-more]this article on Fallout.com[/url], or [url=https://fallout.bethesda.net/en/article/JAbEZ3XV6ViklbHOLMtsC/fallout-76-inside-the-vault-quakecon-recap-and-nuclear-winter-rewards]head here[/url] for more details about how rewards are being distributed.
--- 
[h2]User Interface[/h2] [list]
[*] [b]Pip-Boy:[/b] Junk acquired from scrapping items will now appear in the Pip-Boy’s “New” tab.
[*] [b]Pip-Boy:[/b] Inventory items can now be sorted by their stack weight.
[*] [b]Pip-Boy:[/b] When scrolling in the Pip-Boy inventory, navigating up from the top item in the list will now move the player’s selection to the bottom of the list, and vice versa. [/list]
--- 
[h2]World[/h2] [list]
[*] [b]Vault 51:[/b] Alongside this update for Fallout 76, Vault 51 has now opened up for exploration in all game modes, including Adventure. Follow the red wire to find your way inside, and then poke around to learn more about what befell the Dwellers of Vault 51. [/list]
--- 
[h2]Bug Fixes & Additional Improvements[/h2]
[h3]Art[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Appliances:[/b] Fixed an issue causing parts of the Classic Jukebox to become invisible.
[*] [b]Armor[/b]: The Covert Scout Armor Torso no longer clips through character models that have the muscular body type.
[*] [b]Emotes[/b]: Fixed an issue that could cause a player to become stuck in an Emote animation loop.
[*] [b]Headwear[/b]: Fixed a number of headwear items that include face coverings so that they no longer clip into the faces of female character models.
[*] [b]Melee Weapons[/b]: The Cultist Dagger now plays the correct attack animations.
[*] [b]Power Armor:[/b] Transferring pieces of Strangler Heart Power Armor to a Power Armor Chassis no longer causes duplicate vines to appear and float nearby.
[*] [b]Ranged Weapons[/b]: The Lucille’s Lullaby Paint for the Minigun now correctly applies to the weapon’s Tri-Barrel mod.
[*] [b]Ranged Weapons[/b]: Corrected the direction of the Minigun’s barrel spin while wearing Power Armor.
[*] [b]World[/b]: Objects in Lou’s Mine now animate correctly during the Cheating Death quest. [/list]
[h3]C.A.M.P.s & Workshops[/h3][list]
[*] [b]Appliances:[/b] The RobCo Snow Machine now remains switched off after fast traveling or logging out.
[*] [b]Blueprints[/b]: Creating an auto-blueprint by moving CAMP locations no longer causes the “Store” button to become visually greyed out when that blueprint is selected in build mode.
[*] [b]Budget[/b]: Maximum build counts now correctly account for items that are already stored.
[*] [b]Displays[/b]: Fixed an issue where items could visually fall off of the Display Cases the player had assigned them to.
[*] [b]Lights[/b]: The option that appears when viewing a destroyed Fire Barrel is now correctly labeled “Repair” instead of “Take.”
[*] [b]Shelters:[/b] Standing just outside a C.A.M.P.’s buildable area no longer prevents the player from building a Shelter Entrance within it.
[*] [b]Workshops[/b]: The visual build boundary no longer persists after exiting build mode in the Mount Blair Workshop. [/list]
[h3]Challenges[/h3][list]
[*] [b]Daily[/b]: Cultist Ghouls now correctly count toward Challenges that require players to kill Cultists.
[/list]
[h3]Daily Ops[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Audio[/b]: Daily Ops locations now properly play music that’s specific to the game mode.
[*] [b]Audio[/b]: Weapon sound effects have been slowed down while affected by Freezing Touch.
[*] [b]Contextual Ammo[/b]: When using a Pepper Shaker with a standard magazine, enemies in Daily Ops will now drop shotgun shells more often.
[*] [b]Enemies[/b]: Cultist enemies now correctly display objective markers overhead during Daily Ops inside Vault 96.
[*] [b]Enemies[/b]: Enemies who have rocket launchers no longer stop shooting at the player after firing a single rocket.
[*] [b]Enemies[/b]: Daily Ops bosses no longer prioritize melee attacking the player over using their primary weapons.
[*] [b]Enemies[/b]: Fixed an issue that could cause Mothman Hatchlings to become invincible.
[*] [b]Enemies[/b]: Mothman Hatchlings no longer become unresponsive.
[*] [b]Enemies[/b]: Fixed an issue that could cause Mothman Hatchlings to become stuck in walls after teleporting.
[*] [b]Enemies[/b]: Camouflaged Mothman Hatchlings no longer become invisible while attacking.
[*] [b]Locations[/b]: Entering a Daily Op in Watoga Civic Center during the quest “The Ol’ Weston Shuffle” no longer causes incorrect quest targets to display in the Daily Op instance.
[*] [b]Markers[/b]: Custom map markers no longer appear on the Compass while in a Daily Ops instance.
[*] [b]Mutations[/b]: Enemies with Volatile no longer damage other enemies on death.
[*] [b]Mutations[/b]: All weapons used by “Freezing” enemies will now apply the Freezing Touch effect, except grenades and mines.
[*] [b]Mutations[/b]: The Freezing Touch effect no longer persists on players after leaving a Daily Op.
[*] [b]Mutations[/b]: Getting hit by enemies with Freezing Touch now causes a Freezing Touch effect to appear in the Pip-Boy.
[*] [b]Mutations[/b]: The Toxic Blood effect no longer suddenly stops applying damage.
[*] [b]Mutations[/b]: Enemies with Volatile or Toxic Blood no longer explode and damage players after completing a Daily Op.
[*] [b]Mutations[/b]: Enemies with Group Regeneration now properly heal their nearby companions.
[*] [b]Mutations[/b]: Resilient visual effects no longer persist on enemies after they have been healed.
[*] [b]Mutations[/b]: Shooting enemies with Resilient no longer sometimes causes black decals to appear on their bodies.
[*] [b]Mutations[/b]: Enemies with Resilient no longer display the Resilient visual effects immediately after spawning.
[*] [b]Operation Report[/b]: The description text for Elder Tier rewards now correctly states that it guarantees a rare reward on the player’s first completion.
[*] [b]Operation Report[/b]: Fixed an issue that could cause the Operation Report to display an incredibly high completion time.
[*] [b]Rewards[/b]: Fixed an issue that allowed players to earn Daily Ops rewards more often than intended when playing during the daily reset.
[*] [b]Subtitles[/b]: Adjusted the subtitles for several of Vernon Dodge’s voice lines so that they match his voiceover. [/list]
[h3]Events & Quests [/h3] [list]
[*] [b]A Knight’s Penance[/b]: The Shovel no longer retains its quest item status after clearing the rock wall during the quest.
[*] [b]A Satisfied Conscience[/b]: Picking up a clue during the “Defeat the robots” objective and then logging out no longer prevents this quest from progressing after logging back in.
[*] [b]Field Testing[/b]: Paladin Rahmani now says the correct dialogue based on the player’s choices when asked about the Putnams.
[*] [b]Manhunt[/b]: VATS can now target Mad Dog Malone.
[*] [b]Missing Persons[/b]: Fixed an issue that could prevent players from progressing the quest after finding the Dove Necklace.
[*] [b]Monster Mash[/b]: Being on the event leaderboard no longer prevents the player from joining Daily Ops.
[*] [b]One Violent Night[/b]: Playing an instrument no longer causes enemies to stand still or run away from the player.
[*] [b]The Catalyst[/b]: Russell Dorsey will no longer remain inside Fort Atlas after the quest.
[*] [b]The Elusive Crane[/b]: Fixed an issue that could allow players to repeatedly receive an item reward from the RobCo Cache. [/list]
[h3]Items[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Ammo Converter[/b]: Fixed an issue in which the Ammo Converter would remove or grant Cryo ammo when attempting to sell or buy Fuel.
[*] [b]Apparel[/b]: The Mr. Claus Beard can no longer be equipped at the same time as the Centurion Helmet.
[*] [b]Legendary Cores[/b]: Attempting to transfer a Legendary Core into a container now correctly causes a “You can’t store that here” message to appear.
[*] [b]Legendary Weapons[/b]: Fixed an issue causing melee weapons with the “Reflects 50% of melee damage while blocking” legendary effect to deal more damage than intended.
[*] [b]Melee Weapons[/b]: Players can now properly pick up Sheepsquatch Clubs found in the world.
[*] [b]Ranged Weapons[/b]: Black Powder Weapons now correctly have a “No appearance” mod, and weapon paints the player had previously applied can be removed. [/list]
[h3]Localization[/h3] [list]
[*] [b]Legendary Items[/b]: Removed unnecessary extra words from the prefixes of certain legendary attribute names in non-English versions of the game.
[*] [b]Legendary Power Armor[/b]: Corrected the name of Bolstering Legendary Power Armor mods in the French version of the game.
